normal.explain: 口說表達「INSTRUCTION」(n.)：指示。例句：The instructions were written in English.（這些說明是以英文撰寫的。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：出發
normal.explain: 口說表達「DEPARTURE」(n.)：出發。例句：Our time of departure is 8 AM.（我們的出發時間是早上八點。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：收入
normal.explain: 口說表達「REVENUE」(n.)：收入。例句：Tax revenue declined precipitously during the industrial downturn.（在工業景氣低迷期間政府稅收出現了斷崖式下滑。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：溫度
normal.explain: 口說表達「TEMPERATURE」(n.)：溫度。例句：The nurse took my body temperature twice yesterday morning.（護理師昨天早上量了兩次我的體溫。）

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：助理
normal.explain: 口說表達「ASSISTANT」(n.)：助理。

normal.desc: 請唸出：同意你
normal.explain: 口說表達「AGREE WITH YOU」(phr.)：同意你。

normal.desc: 請唸出：計畫學習
normal.explain: 口說表達「PLAN TO STUDY」(phr.)：計畫學習。

normal.desc: 請唸出：拒絕回答
normal.explain: 口說表達「REFUSE TO ANSWER」(phr.)：拒絕回答。

normal.desc: 請唸出：想像住在那裡
normal.explain: 口說表達「IMAGINE LIVING THERE」(phr.)：想像住在那裡。

normal.desc: 請唸出：需要確認
normal.explain: 口說表達「NEED TO CONFIRM」(phr.)：需要確認。

normal.desc: 請唸出：似乎是對的
normal.explain: 口說表達「SEEMS TO BE RIGHT」(phr.)：似乎是對的。

normal.desc: 請唸出：當時正在拍照
normal.explain: 口說表達「WAS TAKING PICTURES」(phr.)：當時正在拍照。

normal.desc: 請唸出：當時正在談論
normal.explain: 口說表達「WERE TALKING ABOUT」(phr.)：當時正在談論。

normal.desc: 請唸出：比較價格
normal.explain: 口說表達「COMPARING THE PRICES」(phr.)：比較價格。

normal.desc: 請唸出：解釋原因
normal.explain: 口說表達「EXPLAIN THE REASON」(phr.)：解釋原因。

normal.desc: 請唸出：取決於天氣
normal.explain: 口說表達「DEPENDS ON THE WEATHER」(phr.)：取決於天氣。

normal.desc: 請唸出：學習游泳
normal.explain: 口說表達「LEARN TO SWIM」(phr.)：學習游泳。

normal.desc: 請唸出：正在說話的那個男人是我的老闆
normal.ans: THE MAN WHO IS SPEAKING IS MY BOSS
normal.speak: the man who is speaking is my boss
normal.explain: 口說表達「THE MAN WHO IS SPEAKING IS MY BOSS」(phr.)：正在說話的那個男人是我的老闆。

normal.desc: 請唸出：我們當時正在等那班誤點的航班
normal.ans: WE WERE WAITING FOR THE DELAYED FLIGHT
normal.speak: we were waiting for the delayed flight
normal.explain: 口說表達「WE WERE WAITING FOR THE DELAYED FLIGHT」(phr.)：我們當時正在等那班誤點的航班。

normal.desc: 請唸出：我計畫明年出國留學
normal.ans: I PLAN TO STUDY ABROAD NEXT YEAR
normal.speak: i plan to study abroad next year
normal.explain: 口說表達「I PLAN TO STUDY ABROAD NEXT YEAR」(phr.)：我計畫明年出國留學。

normal.desc: 請唸出：她昨天讀完了那份長文件
normal.ans: SHE FINISHED READING THE LONG DOCUMENT YESTERDAY
normal.speak: she finished reading the long document yesterday
normal.explain: 口說表達「SHE FINISHED READING THE LONG DOCUMENT YESTERDAY」(phr.)：她昨天讀完了那份長文件。

normal.desc: 請唸出：他們當時正在看那幅美麗的畫
normal.ans: THEY WERE LOOKING AT THE BEAUTIFUL PAINTING
normal.speak: they were looking at the beautiful painting
normal.explain: 口說表達「THEY WERE LOOKING AT THE BEAUTIFUL PAINTING」(phr.)：他們當時正在看那幅美麗的畫。

normal.desc: 【文法】The new MONUMENT, ___ was built to honor the city's founders, attracts many visitors.
options: A. which
B. who
C. what
D. where
normal.explain: 本題考關係代名詞。先行詞是事物（MONUMENT 紀念碑），且為非限定子句（有逗號隔開），必須使用 which。

normal.desc: 【文法】The city council intends ___ the old bridge before the rainy season begins.
options: A. rebuild
B. to rebuild
C. rebuilding
D. rebuilt
normal.explain: 本題考不定詞用法。動詞 intend（打算）後面必須接不定詞 (to V) 當作受詞，表示未來的意圖。

normal.desc: 【時態】The engineers ___ the soil when they discovered an underground pipe.
options: A. test
B. have tested
C. were testing
D. will test
normal.explain: 本題考過去進行式。句中的 when 引導過去簡單式（discovered），表示在過去的某個時間點突然發生的事，主要子句應用過去進行式表示當時正在進行的動作。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is this the STADIUM ___ the government plans to demolish?
B: Yes, it is too old to be safe.
options: A. that
B. who
C. whom
D. where
normal.explain: 本題考關係代名詞。先行詞 STADIUM（體育場）為事物，作為子句中 plans to demolish 的受詞，可使用 which 或 that，選項中僅 A 正確。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you see the accident at the PAVEMENT?
B: Yes, I ___ for a taxi when the cars collided.
options: A. wait
B. was waiting
C. am waiting
D. waited
normal.explain: 本題考過去進行式。when 帶出過去發生的瞬間動作 (collided)，前面應使用過去進行式 (was waiting) 表達當時正在進行的背景動作。

normal.desc:
【短文】Urban Development: The mayor announced a project to expand the bike lanes. Citizens who cycle to work can expect a safer commute by next year.
Q: What is the main purpose of the project?
options: A. To reduce the cost of bicycles.
B. To ban cars from the city.
C. To provide a safer environment for cyclists.
D. To build more parking spaces.
normal.explain: 閱讀理解題。文中提到專案目的是擴建自行車道，讓騎單車通勤的市民能有更安全的通勤環境（safer commute），故選 C。

normal.desc: 【文法】The ARCHITECT ___ designed the new public library has won several international awards.
options: A. which
B. who
C. whom
D. whose
normal.explain: 本題考關係代名詞。先行詞是人（ARCHITECT 建築師），在關係子句中作主詞（發出 designed 的動作），故選 who。

normal.desc: 【文法】The department manager tolerates ___ late occasionally, but she hates missed deadlines.
options: A. arrive
B. to arrive
C. arriving
D. arrived
normal.explain: 本題考動名詞用法。動詞 tolerate（容忍）後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 當作受詞。

normal.desc: 【文法】My SUPERIOR urged me ___ the conflict with my team member as soon as possible.
options: A. resolve
B. resolving
C. resolved
D. to resolve
normal.explain: 本題考不定詞用法。urge 的用法為 urge someone to do something（敦促某人做某事），後接不定詞。

normal.desc: 【時態】The board members ___ the new marketing budget when the fire alarm interrupted them.
options: A. were debating
B. debate
C. has debated
D. is debating
normal.explain: 本題考過去進行式。when 引導過去簡單式（interrupted）表示突發事件，主要子句應使用過去進行式表示當時正在熱烈討論中。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did the board approve the proposal?
B: No, they postponed ___ a decision until the next quarter.
options: A. make
B. to make
C. making
D. made
normal.explain: 本題考動名詞用法。動詞 postpone（延後）後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 作為受詞。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why didn't you answer my call?
B: I ___ with a difficult client when you called.
options: A. deal
B. to deal
C. have dealt
D. was dealing
normal.explain: 本題考過去進行式。答句表達「當你打來時，我正在處理難搞的客戶」，背景動作應用過去進行式。

normal.desc:
【短文】Office Memo: The HR department is organizing a workshop to help staff communicate better. Employees who struggle with teamwork are highly encouraged to attend.
Q: Who is the primary target of this workshop?
options: A. Staff members who have difficulty working with others.
B. Managers who want to fire underperforming staff.
C. Clients who need better communication skills.
D. New hires who just joined the company.
normal.explain: 閱讀理解題。文中指出強烈鼓勵「在團隊合作上有困難的員工（Employees who struggle with teamwork）」參加，與選項 A 意思相符。

normal.desc: 【文法】The new employee seems ___ a lot of experience in resolving customer complaints.
options: A. have
B. having
C. had
D. to have
normal.explain: 本題考不定詞用法。動詞 seem（似乎）後面必須接不定詞 (to V)。

normal.desc: 【文法】The VACCINE ___ was developed last year has successfully reduced the spread of the virus.
options: A. that
B. who
C. whom
D. whose
normal.explain: 本題考關係代名詞。先行詞 VACCINE（疫苗）為事物，且在子句中作主詞，應使用 which 或 that。

normal.desc: 【文法】Many athletes practice ___ their breath underwater to improve their lung capacity.
options: A. hold
B. holding
C. to hold
D. held
normal.explain: 本題考動名詞用法。動詞 practice（練習）後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 作為受詞。

normal.desc: 【時態】The doctor ___ my SYMPTOM when the clinic lost power.
options: A. evaluates
B. has evaluated
C. was evaluating
D. evaluate
normal.explain: 本題考過去進行式。when 子句為過去式（lost power），表示停電發生的瞬間，醫生「正在」評估症狀，故用過去進行式。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Are those the runners ___ won the MARATHON?
B: No, those are the organizers of the event.
options: A. who
B. which
C. whose
D. whom
normal.explain: 本題考關係代名詞。先行詞 runners（跑者）為人，且在關係子句中擔任主詞，故選 who。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: How did you injure your knee?
B: I ___ for the TOURNAMENT when I tripped on the track.
options: A. train
B. was training
C. am training
D. trained
normal.explain: 本題考過去進行式。tripped（絆倒）是過去發生的瞬間動作，當時正在進行的訓練動作應使用過去進行式。

normal.desc:
【短文】Health Journal: Researchers advise eating more leafy greens. People who consume enough NUTRITION daily have a lower risk of chronic diseases.
Q: According to the journal, what helps lower the risk of chronic diseases?
options: A. Exercising twice a day.
B. Taking vitamin pills regularly.
C. Eating sufficient leafy greens.
D. Drinking plenty of water.
normal.explain: 閱讀理解題。文中提到研究人員建議多吃葉菜類（leafy greens），攝取足夠營養的人患慢性病的風險較低，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【文法】You should consider ___ up yoga if you want to improve your flexibility.
options: A. take
B. taking
C. to take
D. taken
normal.explain: 本題考動名詞用法。動詞 consider（考慮）後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 當受詞。

normal.desc: 【文法】The director arranged ___ the rare SCULPTURE in the main hall of the museum.
options: A. display
B. displaying
C. to display
D. displayed
normal.explain: 本題考不定詞用法。動詞 arrange（安排）後面必須接不定詞 (to V)。

normal.desc: 【文法】We visited an art gallery ___ features works by independent local artists.
options: A. who
B. whom
C. whose
D. which
normal.explain: 本題考關係代名詞。先行詞 art gallery（畫廊）為事物，且在關係子句中作主詞，應選 which。

normal.desc: 【時態】The ORCHESTRA ___ a famous symphony when the lights suddenly went out.
options: A. was performing
B. performs
C. has performed
D. to perform
normal.explain: 本題考過去進行式。燈光突然熄滅（went out）是過去的瞬間動作，樂團當時「正在表演」，應使用過去進行式。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you enjoy the jazz concert?
B: Absolutely, I couldn't resist ___ the CD after the show.
options: A. buy
B. buying
C. to buy
D. bought
normal.explain: 本題考動名詞用法。片語 cannot resist（忍不住）後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Who is the author of this LITERATURE?
B: It was written by a poet ___ works mainly explore nature and love.
options: A. who
B. which
C. whose
D. that
normal.explain: 本題考關係代名詞所有格。poet（詩人）和 works（作品）之間存在所屬關係（詩人的作品），必須使用 whose。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why didn't you talk to the painter?
B: He ___ a portrait of a guest when I walked by, so I didn't want to disturb him.
options: A. is painting
B. paints
C. has painted
D. was painting
normal.explain: 本題考過去進行式。when I walked by 為過去發生的事件，畫家當時正在畫肖像，需用過去進行式。

normal.desc:
【短文】Cultural Festival: The annual film festival, which showcases movies from over fifty countries, will take place next month. Tickets are expected to sell out quickly.
Q: What can be inferred about the film festival?
options: A. It is very popular.
B. It only shows domestic movies.
C. It is free for everyone.
D. It is held every two years.
normal.explain: 閱讀理解題。文中提到門票預計很快就會售罄（Tickets are expected to sell out quickly），可推論出該影展非常受歡迎，故選 A。

normal.desc: 【文法】The classical GENRE, ___ originated centuries ago, is still admired by many music lovers today.
options: A. who
B. what
C. whom
D. which
normal.explain: 本題考關係代名詞。先行詞 GENRE（流派）為事物，且這裡是非限定子句（有逗號隔開），必須使用 which，不能用 that。

normal.desc: 【時態】I ___ my monthly BUDGET when I realized my expenses had doubled.
options: A. was calculating
B. calculate
C. have calculated
D. to calculate
normal.explain: 本題考過去進行式。我意識到（realized）花費翻倍時，當時「正在計算」預算，故使用過去進行式。

normal.desc: 【文法】Before making a large INVESTMENT, you must prioritize ___ your high-interest debt.
options: A. clear
B. clearing
C. to clear
D. cleared
normal.explain: 本題考動名詞用法。動詞 prioritize（優先處理）後面習慣接動名詞 (V-ing) 作為受詞。

normal.desc: 【文法】The government promised ___ financial aid to businesses affected by the INFLATION.
options: A. provide
B. providing
C. to provide
D. provided
normal.explain: 本題考不定詞用法。動詞 promise（承諾）後面必須接不定詞 (to V) 表示承諾要去做的事。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you meet the financial advisor?
B: Yes, he is the expert ___ helped my parents with their retirement plan.
options: A. which
B. whom
C. whose
D. who
normal.explain: 本題考關係代名詞。先行詞 expert（專家）為人，在子句中作主詞，應使用 who。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why was your credit card declined?
B: I ___ an online TRANSACTION overseas, and the bank flagged it as suspicious.
options: A. was making
B. make
C. have made
D. am making
normal.explain: 本題考過去進行式。回答當時發生的情況：我當時「正在進行」一筆海外交易，結果被銀行標記為可疑。需用過去進行式表達當時的動作。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Can we afford this luxury car?
B: I refuse ___ a loan for something that loses value so quickly.
options: A. take
B. to take
C. taking
D. taken
normal.explain: 本題考不定詞用法。動詞 refuse（拒絕）後面必須接不定詞 (to V)。

normal.desc:
【短文】Financial Blog: Many consumers struggle with impulse shopping. Experts suggest waiting at least 24 hours before purchasing anything non-essential to control the urge.
Q: What do experts advise consumers to do?
options: A. Buy things immediately on sale.
B. Use credit cards for every purchase.
C. Delay non-essential purchases for a day.
D. Regret their past shopping habits.
normal.explain: 閱讀理解題。文中專家建議買非必需品前至少等待 24 小時（waiting at least 24 hours），即延遲購買，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【文法】Some investors delay ___ shares in the stock market because they fear a sudden crash.
options: A. buy
B. buying
C. to buy
D. bought
normal.explain: 本題考動名詞用法。動詞 delay（延遲）後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 當作受詞。

normal.desc:
Project Memo: "We are currently running behind schedule on the backend development. We need to allocate additional resources to meet our launch milestone."
Q: What is the main problem stated in the memo?
options: A. The budget was stolen.
B. The project is delayed.
C. The office is closing down.
D. The backend code was deleted.
normal.explain: 「running behind schedule」意為進度落後／延遲（is delayed），需增派人手趕上時程。

normal.desc: 🎧 【商務行程】請聽專案經理留言並確認電話會議時間：
normal.speak: Could we push back our conference call by half an hour to three thirty?
options: A. Cancel the call completely
B. Move it forward to two thirty
C. Delay the call to three thirty
D. Meet in person at three
normal.explain: 「push back... by half an hour to three thirty」意為將通話延後 30 分鐘至 3:30（Delay the call）。

normal.desc: 【職場應對】請唸出向上級提出替代方案的俐落句：「I came up with an alternative solution for the bug.」
normal.speak: I came up with an alternative solution for the bug
normal.ans: I CAME UP WITH AN ALTERNATIVE SOLUTION FOR THE BUG
normal.explain: 口說表達「I CAME UP WITH AN ALTERNATIVE SOLUTION FOR THE BUG」(phr.)：【職場應對】請唸出向上級提出替代方案的俐落句：「I came up with an alternative solution for the bug.」。

normal.desc: 【商務單字】雙方簽署的正式商業「合約」（8個字母）：
normal.explain: CONTRACT (n.)：【商務單字】雙方簽署的正式商業「合約」（8個字母）：。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The customer was complaining about the service when the manager intervened.
options: A. 當經理介入時，顧客正在抱怨服務。
B. 顧客抱怨完服務後，經理才介入。
C. 經理正在抱怨服務，顧客於是介入。
D. 顧客要求經理出面抱怨服務。
boss.explain: The customer was complaining... when the manager intervened. 意思是「經理介入時，顧客正在抱怨服務。」（過去進行式搭配過去式）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The document that you requested has been attached to this email.
options: A. 你附上的文件需要用電子郵件寄出。
B. 你要求的文件已經附在這封電子郵件裡了。
C. 這封電子郵件是你要求的文件。
D. 我要求你將文件附在電子郵件裡。
boss.explain: The document that you requested... 意思是「你要求的那份文件已經作為附件隨信附上。」（關係代名詞 that）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We regret to inform you that your application was denied.
options: A. 我們很遺憾你的申請表寫錯了。
B. 我們很遺憾地通知您，您的申請被拒絕了。
C. 我們忘記通知您，您的申請已被拒絕。
D. 您很遺憾地拒絕了我們的申請。
boss.explain: We regret to inform you... 意思是「我們很遺憾地通知您，申請已被拒絕。」（regret to V 遺憾要去做某事）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: He finished writing the proposal just before the deadline.
options: A. 他在截止日期後才寫完提案。
B. 他在截止日期前剛好寫完提案。
C. 他提議在截止日期前寫完文件。
D. 截止日期前他根本還沒開始寫提案。
boss.explain: He finished writing the proposal... 意思是「他在截止期限前剛好寫完提案。」（finish + V-ing）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The flight attendant recommended keeping our seatbelts fastened.
options: A. 空服員建議我們保持安全帶扣好。
B. 空服員推薦我們買一條新的安全帶。
C. 空服員提醒我們解開安全帶。
D. 空服員堅持自己要扣好安全帶。
boss.explain: The flight attendant recommended keeping... 意思是「空服員建議保持安全帶繫好。」（recommend + V-ing）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Were they discussing the new budget when you entered the room?
options: A. The room is very bright and spacious.
B. Yes, they were going over the numbers for next year.
C. I entered the room quietly.
D. They discuss the budget every week.
boss.explain: 問句：你進房間時，他們正在討論新預算嗎？（過去進行式）。B「是的，他們正在看明年的數字」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The reporter who broke the news is being interviewed on channel five.
options: A. Let's turn it on and watch what he has to say.
B. The news is very depressing today.
C. Breaking the rules is not allowed.
D. Channel five is a good channel.
boss.explain: 句子：爆出這則新聞的記者正在第五頻道接受採訪（關係代名詞 who）。A「我們打開電視看看他怎麼說吧」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Do you remember sending the itinerary to the clients?
options: A. The itinerary is very detailed.
B. Yes, I emailed it to them yesterday morning.
C. I remember nothing about the client.
D. Sending emails is part of my job.
boss.explain: 問句：你記得有把行程表寄給客戶嗎？（remember + V-ing 記得做過某事）。B「記得，我昨天早上用Email寄給他們了」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The doctor promised to call me as soon as the test results are ready.
options: A. The test was very difficult.
B. That's good. I hope everything turns out fine.
C. Doctors are usually very busy.
D. I promise to be there on time.
boss.explain: 句子：醫生答應檢驗結果一出來就會打電話給我（promise to V）。B「太好了，希望一切順利」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: We are committed to providing the best possible service.
options: A. I am not committed to this relationship.
B. That's why your company has such a great reputation.
C. Providing service is very hard.
D. The best is yet to come.
boss.explain: 句子：我們致力於提供最好的服務（be committed to + V-ing）。B「這就是為什麼你們公司有這麼好的聲譽」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The medication which I took last night made me feel drowsy all morning.
options: A. You should probably ask the pharmacist if that's a normal side effect.
B. I like taking medication.
C. The morning is the best time of the day.
D. Drowsiness is not a disease.
boss.explain: 句子：我昨晚吃的藥讓我整個早上都昏昏欲睡（關係代名詞 which）。A「你或許該問問藥師那是否為正常的副作用」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: She managed to resolve the customer's issue without escalating it to management.
options: A. The issue is very complicated.
B. That's impressive. She has excellent problem-solving skills.
C. Management is always right.
D. Escalating an issue is not recommended.
boss.explain: 句子：她成功解決了客戶的問題，而沒有往上呈報給管理層（manage to V）。B「真令人佩服，她有很棒的解決問題能力」最合適。

boss.desc: 【文法】The management team is considering ___ a four-day workweek to boost employee morale.
options: A. to implement
B. implementing
C. implement
D. implemented
boss.explain: consider（考慮）作為動詞時，後方須接動名詞（V-ing）當作受詞。

boss.desc: 【短文】Tech Magazine: The startup, which was founded by two university students, recently secured a million-dollar investment. Their app helps people track their daily carbon footprint. Q: What is true about the startup?
options: A. It was founded by investors.
B. It tracks people's physical steps.
C. It was created by university students.
D. It lost a million dollars.
boss.explain: 短文中提到「which was founded by two university students」，表示這家新創公司是兩位大學生創辦的。

boss.desc: 【文法】We met a consultant yesterday ___ advice saved our company from bankruptcy.
options: A. who
B. whom
C. whose
D. which
boss.explain: 先行詞 consultant（顧問）與 advice（建議）之間具有所有格關係（那位顧問的建議），故填 whose。

boss.desc: 【時態】I couldn't hear what the speaker was saying because the people behind me ___ loudly.
options: A. talk
B. are talking
C. were talking
D. will talk
boss.explain: 主要子句（couldn't hear）是過去式，表示當時聽不到是因為後面的人「當時正在」大聲說話，需用過去進行式。

boss.desc: 【短文】Travel Alert: Passengers who are traveling to Tokyo should proceed to Gate 5 immediately. The flight, which was delayed due to bad weather, is now ready for boarding. Q: Why was the flight delayed?
options: A. Because of a technical issue.
B. Because the gate was changed.
C. Because of bad weather.
D. Because passengers were late.
boss.explain: 文中明確寫出「delayed due to bad weather」，即因為天氣惡劣而延誤。

boss.desc: 【文法】It is generally a good idea to avoid ___ sensitive personal questions during a job interview.
options: A. to ask
B. ask
C. asking
D. asked
boss.explain: avoid 後面必須接動名詞（V-ing），表示避免做某件事。

boss.desc: 【短文】Biography: Maria, who spent her childhood in a small village, always dreamed of becoming an architect. She was sketching buildings while other kids were playing outside. Q: What did Maria do when other kids played outside?
options: A. She played with them.
B. She sketched buildings.
C. She visited architects.
D. She explored the village.
boss.explain: 文章指出「She was sketching buildings while other kids were playing outside.」，選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Company Policy: Employees are expected to stop taking personal calls during working hours. If there is an emergency, please use the designated break area. Q: What does the policy ask employees to do?
options: A. Stop to make personal calls anytime.
B. Use the break area for all work calls.
C. Cease making personal calls while working.
D. Stop working to take personal calls.
boss.explain: stop taking personal calls 意思是「停止接聽私人電話（不再做這件事）」，cease 即為 stop 的同義字，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【時態】While the government ___ to find a solution to the pollution problem, local activists organized a massive cleanup event on the beach.
options: A. struggles
B. was struggling
C. has struggled
D. is struggling
boss.explain: 後半句為過去簡單式（organized），While 帶出的背景動作通常為過去進行式，表示當時政府正為了找尋解方而努力。

boss.desc: 【文法】The manager threatened ___ the employee if he continued to be late for work.
options: A. firing
B. fire
C. to fire
D. fired
boss.explain: threaten（威脅）後面須接不定詞（to V），表示威脅要去做某事。

boss.desc: 【短文】Wildlife Conservation: The organization focuses on protecting sea turtles, which are currently facing extinction due to habitat loss. Volunteers patrol the beaches every night. Q: What is causing the sea turtles to face extinction?
options: A. Volunteer patrols.
B. Habitat loss.
C. Climate cooling.
D. Lack of food.
boss.explain: 文中提到「facing extinction due to habitat loss」，due to 表示原因，即棲息地喪失。

boss.desc: 【文法】The old bridge ___ collapsed yesterday was built over a hundred years ago.
options: A. who
B. that
C. where
D. what
boss.explain: 修飾事物（bridge）且在子句中作主詞，這裡沒有逗號（限定用法），用 that 或 which 皆可，選項中只有 that 符合。

boss.desc: 【對話】A: Did you see Jim? B: He ___ the presentation materials when I left the office, so he might still be there.
options: A. prepares
B. was preparing
C. has prepared
D. will prepare
boss.explain: 根據 when I left the office（當我離開辦公室時），表達在那個過去的時間點 Jim 正在準備資料，故選 B。

boss.desc: 請唸出：幫忙的同事
boss.speak: the colleague who helped
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE COLLEAGUE WHO HELPED」(phr.)：幫忙的同事。

boss.desc: 請唸出：考慮換工作
boss.speak: consider changing jobs
boss.explain: 口說表達「CONSIDER CHANGING JOBS」(phr.)：考慮換工作。

boss.desc: 請唸出：當時正在準備
boss.speak: was preparing for
boss.explain: 口說表達「WAS PREPARING FOR」(phr.)：當時正在準備。

boss.desc: 請唸出：她當時正在準備會議
boss.ans: SHE WAS PREPARING FOR THE MEETING
boss.speak: she was preparing for the meeting
boss.explain: 口說表達「SHE WAS PREPARING FOR THE MEETING」(phr.)：她當時正在準備會議。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我避免在尖峰時間開車
boss.ans: I AVOID DRIVING DURING RUSH HOUR
boss.speak: i avoid driving during rush hour
boss.explain: 口說表達「I AVOID DRIVING DURING RUSH HOUR」(phr.)：我避免在尖峰時間開車。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們選的飯店很棒
boss.ans: THE HOTEL WHICH WE CHOSE WAS GREAT
boss.speak: the hotel which we chose was great
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE HOTEL WHICH WE CHOSE WAS GREAT」(phr.)：我們選的飯店很棒。

boss.desc: 請唸出：你介意更改時程表嗎
boss.ans: DO YOU MIND CHANGING THE SCHEDULE
boss.speak: do you mind changing the schedule
boss.explain: 口說表達「DO YOU MIND CHANGING THE SCHEDULE」(phr.)：你介意更改時程表嗎。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他拒絕簽署合約
boss.ans: HE REFUSED TO SIGN THE CONTRACT
boss.speak: he refused to sign the contract
boss.explain: 口說表達「HE REFUSED TO SIGN THE CONTRACT」(phr.)：他拒絕簽署合約。

boss.desc: 請唸出：她來的時候我正在看書
boss.ans: I WAS READING WHEN SHE CAME
boss.speak: i was reading when she came
boss.explain: 口說表達「I WAS READING WHEN SHE CAME」(phr.)：她來的時候我正在看書。

boss.desc: 請唸出：昨天來拜訪我們的客戶
boss.ans: THE CLIENT WHO VISITED US YESTERDAY
boss.speak: the client who visited us yesterday
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE CLIENT WHO VISITED US YESTERDAY」(phr.)：昨天來拜訪我們的客戶。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們期待與您見面
boss.ans: WE LOOK FORWARD TO SEEING YOU
boss.speak: we look forward to seeing you
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE LOOK FORWARD TO SEEING YOU」(phr.)：我們期待與您見面。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他們建議去海灘
boss.ans: THEY SUGGESTED GOING TO THE BEACH
boss.speak: they suggested going to the beach
boss.explain: 口說表達「THEY SUGGESTED GOING TO THE BEACH」(phr.)：他們建議去海灘。

boss.desc: 請拼出：主管/監督者
boss.speak: supervisor
boss.explain: SUPERVISOR (n.)：主管/監督者。例句：The supervisor who trained me expects everyone to work efficiently.（培訓我的主管期望每個人都能有效率地工作。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S U P _ R V _ S _ R (主管/監督者)
boss.speak: supervisor
boss.explain: SUPERVISOR (n.)：主管/監督者。填空答案為「EIO」。例句：The supervisor who trained me expects everyone to work efficiently.（培訓我的主管期望每個人都能有效率地工作。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C _ M M U N _ C A T _ (溝通)
boss.speak: communicate
boss.explain: COMMUNICATE (v.)：溝通。填空答案為「OIE」。例句：They have communicated the new policy to the team.（他們已經向團隊傳達了新政策。）

boss.desc: 填空題：O P P _ R T U N _ T _ (機會)
boss.speak: opportunity
boss.explain: OPPORTUNITY (n.)：機會。填空答案為「OIY」。例句：I have waited for this career opportunity for years.（我已經等這個職業機會好幾年了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A C C _ M M O D _ T I _ N (住宿)
boss.speak: accommodation
boss.explain: ACCOMMODATION (n.)：住宿。填空答案為「OAO」。例句：Our accommodation has been booked for the trip.（我們這趟旅行的住宿已經預訂好了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A P _ L O G _ Z _ (道歉)
boss.speak: apologize
boss.explain: APOLOGIZE (v.)：道歉。填空答案為「OIE」。例句：I must apologize to him.（我必須向他道歉。）

boss.desc: 填空題：D _ S T I N _ T I _ N (目的地)
boss.speak: destination
boss.explain: DESTINATION (n.)：目的地。填空答案為「EAO」。例句：Tainan was our favorite travel destination last summer.（台南是我們去年夏天最喜歡的旅遊目的地。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The package which arrived today is for you.
options: A. 你今天要寄出一個包裹。
B. 昨天抵達的包裹是給你的。
C. 今天送達的那個包裹是給你的。
D. 你必須今天去領取這個包裹。
boss.explain: 原句：The package which arrived today is for you. (今天送達的那個包裹是給你的。) 測試關係代名詞 which 較長句型。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: I finished reading the report last night.
options: A. 我昨晚把報告寫完了。
B. 我昨晚讀完了那份報告。
C. 昨晚的報告終於結束了。
D. 我打算今晚讀完這份報告。
boss.explain: 原句：I finished reading the report last night. (我昨晚讀完了那份報告。) 測試 finish + V-ing。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We decided to hire a new assistant.
options: A. 我們正在面試新的助理。
B. 助理決定要辭職了。
C. 我們決定要聘請一位新助理。
D. 新助理決定要接受這份工作。
boss.explain: 原句：We decided to hire a new assistant. (我們決定要聘請一位新助理。) 測試 decide to + V。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Thank you for calling customer service. How can I help you today?
options: A. I called you yesterday morning.
B. I am trying to track a missing order.
C. The service here is excellent.
D. How do you help customers?
boss.explain: 原句：Thank you for calling customer service. How can I help you today? (感謝致電客服，今天能怎麼幫忙您？) 客戶常回答目的，故選 B (我正在試著追蹤一筆遺失的訂單)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Attention all passengers. Flight 808 is now boarding at gate twelve.
options: A. 808 航班已經在十二號登機門起飛了。
B. 請注意，808 航班更改到十二號登機門。
C. 各位旅客請注意，808 航班現在於十二號登機門開始登機。
D. 808 航班的旅客請前往十二號登機門領取行李。
boss.explain: 原句：Attention all passengers. Flight 808 is now boarding at gate twelve. 機場廣播情境，boarding 意為「登機」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The pharmacy that is open 24 hours is located on Main Street.
options: A. 位於主街的藥局今晚會開到 24 點。
B. 那間 24 小時營業的藥局位在主街上。
C. 主街上新開了一家 24 小時營業的藥局。
D. 藥局老闆在主街上開了 24 個小時的車。
boss.explain: 原句：The pharmacy that is open 24 hours is located on Main Street. (那間 24 小時營業的藥局位在主街上。) 測試關係代名詞 that。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: I highly recommend taking a taxi if you are in a hurry.
options: A. 如果你很趕時間，我強烈建議你搭計程車。
B. 我建議計程車司機開快一點，因為我很趕時間。
C. 雖然你很急，但我還是不建議你搭計程車。
D. 這位計程車司機非常推薦你慢慢來。
boss.explain: 原句：I highly recommend taking a taxi if you are in a hurry. (如果你很趕時間，我強烈建議你搭計程車。) 測試 recommend + V-ing。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: I apologize for the delay. We are currently experiencing high call volumes.
options: A. 很抱歉讓您久等，我們正在調整通話音量。
B. 對於延遲感到抱歉，目前我們的進線量非常大。
C. 我為延遲道歉，請您大聲一點說話。
D. 因為電話數量不足，導致我們的服務延遲，請見諒。
boss.explain: 原句：I apologize for the delay. We are currently experiencing high call volumes. (對於延遲感到抱歉，目前我們的進線量非常大。) 常見客服用語。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: They are planning to renovate the lobby next month.
options: A. 他們上個月剛剛翻修完大廳。
B. 他們計畫在下個月翻修大廳。
C. 下個月的大廳會非常熱鬧。
D. 大廳的翻修計畫被延到下個月了。
boss.explain: 原句：They are planning to renovate the lobby next month. (他們計畫在下個月翻修大廳。) 測試 plan to + V。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Are you taking any medication for those symptoms?
options: A. Yes, I take the train every day.
B. I am feeling much better now.
C. Yes, the doctor prescribed some pills.
D. No, I haven't meditated lately.
boss.explain: 原句：Are you taking any medication for those symptoms? (你有針對那些症狀服用任何藥物嗎？) 詢問醫療狀況，回答 C (有，醫生開了一些藥丸) 最正確。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The guest who is staying in room 302 needs some extra towels.
options: A. 住在 302 號房的客人需要一些額外的毛巾。
B. 302 號房的客人剛剛送來了一些毛巾。
C. 請問 302 號房的客人還需要毛巾嗎？
D. 客房服務正在為 302 號房準備毛巾。
boss.explain: 原句：The guest who is staying in room 302 needs some extra towels. (住在 302 號房的客人需要一些額外的毛巾。) 測試關係代名詞 who。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I would like to speak to the person who is in charge of marketing.
options: A. I will charge your credit card now.
B. Speaking. How can I assist you?
C. He is charging his phone.
D. Marketing is a very difficult job.
boss.explain: 原句：I would like to speak to the person who is in charge of marketing. (我想跟負責行銷的人說話。) 回答 B (我就是。能怎麼幫忙您？) 是商業通話中標準的接話方式。

boss.desc: 【短文】Health Report: A recent survey shows that office workers who sit for more than eight hours a day face a higher risk of back pain. The researchers urge people to take short walks. Q: What does the report say about office workers?
options: A. They may suffer from back pain if they sit too long.
B. They should sleep for eight hours a day.
C. They are urged to buy new office chairs.
D. They face a higher risk of heart disease.
boss.explain: 文中提到久坐超過八小時的辦公室員工面臨較高的背痛風險 (face a higher risk of back pain)，因此選 A。其他選項文中皆未提及。

boss.desc: 【短文】Sleep Study: While doctors were observing the volunteers, they found that those who listened to soft music fell asleep faster. The study aims to help people with sleep problems. Q: What happened during the observation?
options: A. Volunteers played musical instruments.
B. Soft music helped volunteers fall asleep sooner.
C. Doctors fell asleep while listening to music.
D. Volunteers refused to listen to any music.
boss.explain: 文中提到「those who listened to soft music fell asleep faster（聽輕音樂的人更快入睡）」，符合 B 的描述。C 是醫生睡著，錯誤。

boss.desc: 【短文】Clinic Notice: Patients who suffer from severe seasonal allergies should avoid outdoor activities during the spring. The clinic offers free allergy tests this month. Q: What does the clinic offer this month?
options: A. Free medicine.
B. Outdoor activities.
C. Free allergy tests.
D. Spring vacation packages.
boss.explain: 告示中最後一句明確寫道「The clinic offers free allergy tests this month. (診所本月提供免費過敏測試)」，因此選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】Traffic Update: The main bridge, which crosses the river, is temporarily closed for maintenance. Drivers are advised to use the alternate route through the tunnel. Q: Why should drivers use the tunnel?
options: A. The tunnel is faster.
B. The river is flooding.
C. The main bridge is under maintenance.
D. There is an accident on the bridge.
boss.explain: 文中提到「The main bridge... is temporarily closed for maintenance (主橋因維修暫時封閉)」，所以建議駕駛改走隧道，選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】City Notice: The government plans to build a new park in the center of the city. The project, which will begin next year, aims to provide a green space for families. Q: What is the purpose of the new project?
options: A. To build a new parking lot.
B. To create a green area for families.
C. To start a city government office.
D. To plant trees along the highway.
boss.explain: 文中說明這個計畫的目的是「aims to provide a green space for families (旨在為家庭提供綠地)」，因此正確答案是 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Policy Change: Starting in January, cars that enter the city center during rush hour will be charged a fee. The fee is designed to decrease air pollution. Q: Which cars will be charged?
options: A. Cars entering the city center during peak hours.
B. All cars driving outside the city.
C. Cars parked in the city center overnight.
D. Cars that are electric and eco-friendly.
boss.explain: 文中提到「cars that enter the city center during rush hour will be charged a fee」，rush hour 同義於 peak hours（尖峰時段），故選 A。

boss.desc: 【短文】HR Memo: The specialist who usually handles conflict resolution is currently on leave. If you face any urgent issues, please contact the department head directly. Q: Who should employees contact for urgent issues?
options: A. The specialist on leave.
B. The department head.
C. The security guard.
D. The police.
boss.explain: 備忘錄指出專家目前休假中，遇到緊急問題請直接聯絡「the department head (部門主管)」，因此選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Email Etiquette: Professionals who write clear and concise emails often save their coworkers a lot of time. It is best to keep the subject line direct. Q: What is the benefit of writing clear emails?
options: A. It guarantees a promotion.
B. It makes the email look longer.
C. It saves coworkers' time.
D. It hides the main topic.
boss.explain: 文中提到清楚簡潔的郵件「often save their coworkers a lot of time (經常能節省同事的時間)」，所以選 C。

boss.desc: 【短文】Workshop Memo: The communication workshop will focus on active listening. Employees attending the session must turn off their phones to avoid distracting others. Q: What is required of the employees in the workshop?
options: A. To bring their laptops.
B. To turn off their mobile phones.
C. To talk continuously.
D. To distract other people.
boss.explain: 備忘錄中明確規定參加者「must turn off their phones (必須關閉手機)」，以避免干擾他人，故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Cultural Event: The night market, which attracts thousands of visitors every weekend, features various local snacks and games. It is a perfect place to experience the local lifestyle. Q: What can visitors do at the night market?
options: A. Try local snacks and games.
B. Buy international airline tickets.
C. Watch traditional indoor theater.
D. Avoid crowded places.
boss.explain: 文中說夜市「features various local snacks and games (以各種當地小吃和遊戲為特色)」，所以遊客可以嘗試小吃和遊戲，選 A。

boss.desc: 【短文】Return Policy: Buyers should consider returning the item if it does not match the description online. A full refund will be processed within seven business days. Q: Under what condition should a buyer return an item?
options: A. If it is different from the online description.
B. If they used it for a year.
C. If they want a different color.
D. If it arrives earlier than expected.
boss.explain: 文中提到「if it does not match the description online (如果不符合網路上的描述)」，同義於 A 選項的 different from the online description。

boss.desc: 【短文】Consumer Rights: If an item is faulty, buyers have the right to demand a replacement or a refund. Stores that deny this right can be reported to the consumer protection agency. Q: What can buyers do if they purchase a faulty item?
options: A. They must fix the item themselves.
B. They can ask for a replacement or get their money back.
C. They have to report it to the police.
D. They should ignore the problem.
boss.explain: 文章說買家有權利「demand a replacement or a refund (要求換貨或退款)」，這與 B 選項的意思完全一致。

boss.desc: 【短文】Product Recall: The manufacturer is recalling the electric kettles because they overheat easily. Anyone who owns this model should stop using it immediately. Q: Why are the electric kettles being recalled?
options: A. They are too small.
B. They use too much electricity.
C. They are not popular.
D. They get too hot and may be dangerous.
boss.explain: 文中表示召回熱水壺是因為它們「overheat easily (容易過熱)」，對應到 D 選項的 get too hot and may be dangerous。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我正在寫郵件時電腦當機了
boss.ans: I WAS WRITING AN EMAIL WHEN MY COMPUTER CRASHED
boss.speak: i was writing an email when my computer crashed
boss.explain: 口說表達「I WAS WRITING AN EMAIL WHEN MY COMPUTER CRASHED」(phr.)：我正在寫郵件時電腦當機了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：那個幫助我的經理非常友善
boss.ans: THE MANAGER WHO HELPED ME WAS VERY FRIENDLY
boss.speak: the manager who helped me was very friendly
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE MANAGER WHO HELPED ME WAS VERY FRIENDLY」(phr.)：那個幫助我的經理非常友善。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們參觀了那座有名的城堡
boss.ans: WE VISITED THE CASTLE WHICH IS VERY FAMOUS
boss.speak: we visited the castle which is very famous
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE VISITED THE CASTLE WHICH IS VERY FAMOUS」(phr.)：我們參觀了那座有名的城堡。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我正在考慮去歐洲旅行
boss.ans: I AM CONSIDERING TRAVELING TO EUROPE
boss.speak: i am considering traveling to europe
boss.explain: 口說表達「I AM CONSIDERING TRAVELING TO EUROPE」(phr.)：我正在考慮去歐洲旅行。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他答應明天會完成報告
boss.ans: HE PROMISED TO FINISH THE REPORT TOMORROW
boss.speak: he promised to finish the report tomorrow
boss.explain: 口說表達「HE PROMISED TO FINISH THE REPORT TOMORROW」(phr.)：他答應明天會完成報告。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我建議搭火車去那裡
boss.ans: I RECOMMEND TAKING THE TRAIN THERE
boss.speak: i recommend taking the train there
boss.explain: 口說表達「I RECOMMEND TAKING THE TRAIN THERE」(phr.)：我建議搭火車去那裡。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們正在等行李的時候聊了天
boss.ans: WE CHATTED WHILE WE WERE WAITING FOR THE LUGGAGE
boss.speak: we chatted while we were waiting for the luggage
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE CHATTED WHILE WE WERE WAITING FOR THE LUGGAGE」(phr.)：我們正在等行李的時候聊了天。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這就是我昨天提到的那間餐廳
boss.ans: THIS IS THE RESTAURANT WHICH I MENTIONED YESTERDAY
boss.speak: this is the restaurant which i mentioned yesterday
boss.explain: 口說表達「THIS IS THE RESTAURANT WHICH I MENTIONED YESTERDAY」(phr.)：這就是我昨天提到的那間餐廳。

boss.desc: 請唸出：她正在做簡報時麥克風壞了
boss.ans: THE MICROPHONE BROKE WHILE SHE WAS GIVING THE PRESENTATION
boss.speak: the microphone broke while she was giving the presentation
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE MICROPHONE BROKE WHILE SHE WAS GIVING THE PRESENTATION」(phr.)：她正在做簡報時麥克風壞了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：你介意把會議延後嗎
boss.ans: DO YOU MIND POSTPONING THE MEETING
boss.speak: do you mind postponing the meeting
boss.explain: 口說表達「DO YOU MIND POSTPONING THE MEETING」(phr.)：你介意把會議延後嗎。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我期待下個月的假期
boss.ans: I AM LOOKING FORWARD TO THE VACATION NEXT MONTH
boss.speak: i am looking forward to the vacation next month
boss.explain: 口說表達「I AM LOOKING FORWARD TO THE VACATION NEXT MONTH」(phr.)：我期待下個月的假期。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他出國時正在學習法文
boss.ans: HE WAS STUDYING FRENCH WHEN HE WENT ABROAD
boss.speak: he was studying french when he went abroad
boss.explain: 口說表達「HE WAS STUDYING FRENCH WHEN HE WENT ABROAD」(phr.)：他出國時正在學習法文。

boss.desc: 請拼出：欣賞/感謝
boss.speak: appreciate
boss.explain: APPRECIATE (v.)：感謝。例句：We appreciate the time you took to read our product description.（我們感謝您撥冗閱讀我們的產品說明。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：氣氛
boss.speak: atmosphere
boss.explain: ATMOSPHERE (n.)：氣氛。例句：They were enjoying the relaxing atmosphere when it started to rain.（當開始下雨時，他們正在享受放鬆的氣氛。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：難忘的
boss.speak: memorable
boss.explain: MEMORABLE (adj.)：難忘的。例句：The trip that we took last month was truly memorable.（我們上個月去的旅行真的是令人難忘的。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：行程
boss.speak: itinerary
boss.explain: ITINERARY (n.)：行程。例句：Planning a detailed itinerary requires a lot of research.（規劃一份詳細的行程需要做很多研究。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：觀光
boss.speak: sightseeing
boss.explain: SIGHTSEEING (n.)：觀光。例句：Going sightseeing is my favorite part of traveling.（去觀光是我旅行中最喜歡的部分。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：責任
boss.speak: responsibility
boss.explain: RESPONSIBILITY (n.)：責任。例句：Taking responsibility for your actions is a sign of maturity.（對自己的行為負起責任是成熟的表現。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A P P R _ C I _ T _ (欣賞/感謝)
boss.speak: appreciate
boss.explain: APPRECIATE (v.)：欣賞/感謝。填空答案為「EAE」。例句：We appreciate the time you took to read our product description.（我們感謝您撥冗閱讀我們的產品說明。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A T M _ S P H _ R _ (氣氛)
boss.speak: atmosphere
boss.explain: ATMOSPHERE (n.)：氣氛。填空答案為「OEE」。例句：They were enjoying the relaxing atmosphere when it started to rain.（當開始下雨時，他們正在享受放鬆的氣氛。）

boss.desc: 填空題：M E M _ R _ B L _ (難忘的)
boss.speak: memorable
boss.explain: MEMORABLE (adj.)：難忘的。填空答案為「OAE」。例句：The trip that we took last month was truly memorable.（我們上個月去的旅行真的是令人難忘的。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R _ Q U I R _ M E N _ (要求/必要條件)
boss.speak: requirement
boss.explain: REQUIREMENT (n.)：要求/必要條件。填空答案為「EET」。例句：Speaking English is a basic requirement for this job.（會說英文是這份工作的基本要求。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R _ G U L _ T I O _ (規定)
boss.speak: regulation
boss.explain: REGULATION (n.)：規定。填空答案為「EAN」。

boss.desc: 填空題：I T _ N _ R A R _ (行程)
boss.speak: itinerary
boss.explain: ITINERARY (n.)：行程。填空答案為「IEY」。例句：Planning a detailed itinerary requires a lot of research.（規劃一份詳細的行程需要做很多研究。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S _ G H T S _ _ I N G (觀光)
boss.speak: sightseeing
boss.explain: SIGHTSEEING (n.)：觀光。填空答案為「IEE」。例句：Going sightseeing is my favorite part of traveling.（去觀光是我旅行中最喜歡的部分。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C _ R R _ N C _ (貨幣)
boss.speak: currency
boss.explain: CURRENCY (n.)：貨幣。填空答案為「UEY」。例句：Exchanging foreign currency is easy at this airport.（在這個機場兌換外國貨幣很容易。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R E S P _ N S I B _ L I T _ (責任)
boss.speak: responsibility
boss.explain: RESPONSIBILITY (n.)：責任。填空答案為「OIY」。例句：Taking responsibility for your actions is a sign of maturity.（對自己的行為負起責任是成熟的表現。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Is he the guest speaker who is giving the talk on economics?
options: A. Yes, he just arrived from London.
B. He was speaking to the manager.
C. I think the economy is improving.
D. No, the microphone is broken.
boss.explain: 原句：Is he the guest speaker who is giving the talk on economics? 意思：他是那位要進行經濟學演講的客座講者嗎？正確回應是 A. 是的，他剛從倫敦抵達。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: We need to figure out how to operate this new projector.
options: A. The project will be finished soon.
B. Let me ask the technician for help.
C. I was projecting the sales figures.
D. It operates on batteries only.
boss.explain: 原句：We need to figure out how to operate this new projector. 意思：我們需要弄清楚怎麼操作這台新投影機。正確回應是 B. 讓我找技師幫忙。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Is this the trophy that they won at the championship?
options: A. The champion is very strong.
B. Yes, they are going to win.
C. Yes, it was presented to them yesterday.
D. No, the championship is next week.
boss.explain: 原句：Is this the trophy that they won at the championship? 意思：這是他們在錦標賽贏得的獎盃嗎？正確回應是 C. 是的，這是昨天頒發給他們的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: What were the coaches explaining before the second half started?
options: A. They will discuss the strategy soon.
B. The second half is about to begin.
C. I discussed it with my team.
D. They were talking about changing the defensive strategy.
boss.explain: 原句：What were the coaches explaining before the second half started? 意思：下半場開始前教練們在解說什麼？正確回應是 D. 他們正在談論改變防守策略。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Can I speak to the staff member who handled my bags?
options: A. He is currently on a break, but I can assist you.
B. The bags are very heavy.
C. I can handle the situation for you.
D. You spoke to the manager yesterday.
boss.explain: 原句：Can I speak to the staff member who handled my bags? 意思：我可以和處理我行李的那位員工說話嗎？正確回應是 A. 他目前在休息，但我可以協助您。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Is it possible to extend our stay for one more night?
options: A. The night is very beautiful here.
B. Let me check if we have any rooms available.
C. You stayed here for three nights.
D. It is not possible to stay awake all night.
boss.explain: 原句：Is it possible to extend our stay for one more night? 意思：我們有可能多住一晚嗎？正確回應是 B. 讓我查一下我們是否還有空房。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: What is the best route that bypasses the construction on Main Street?
options: A. The construction will finish next month.
B. I built that street a long time ago.
C. You should take First Avenue to bypass it completely.
D. Main Street is very beautiful in the spring.
boss.explain: 原句：What is the best route that bypasses the construction on Main Street? 意思：避開主街施工的最佳路線是什麼？正確回應是 C. 你應該走第一大道來完全避開它。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: How long is it going to take to clear the road after the landslide?
options: A. The road is very long and winding.
B. I took the road less traveled.
C. The landslide happened yesterday morning.
D. The authorities expect to have it open by tomorrow evening.
boss.explain: 原句：How long is it going to take to clear the road after the landslide? 意思：土石流後清理道路需要多長時間？正確回應是 D. 當局預計明天傍晚能開放通行。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Do you know anyone who can help us set up the barbecue grill?
options: A. My brother is pretty good at assembling things.
B. The barbecue was very delicious.
C. I know a place where we can buy a grill.
D. We set it up yesterday afternoon.
boss.explain: 原句：Do you know anyone who can help us set up the barbecue grill? 意思：你認識能幫我們組裝烤肉架的人嗎？正確回應是 A. 我弟弟很擅長組裝東西。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Were you thinking of going hiking if the weather clears up?
options: A. The weather is getting much worse.
B. Yes, but it looks like the rain won't stop.
C. I planned the entire trip carefully.
D. The hiking trail is closed for maintenance.
boss.explain: 原句：Were you thinking of going hiking if the weather clears up? 意思：天氣放晴的話你有考慮去爬山嗎？正確回應是 B. 是的，但看起來雨是不會停了。

boss.desc:
【短文】Travel Blog: Yesterday, while we were hiking up the mountain, my camera battery died. I couldn't take any pictures of the sunset.
Q: What was the writer doing when the battery died?
options: A. Hiking up the mountain.
B. Taking pictures.
C. Fixing the camera.
D. Watching the sunset.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章明確提到「while we were hiking up the mountain, my camera battery died (當我們正在爬山時，相機沒電了)」，故選 A。

boss.desc:
【短文】Science News: The new telescope, which was built in Chile, has captured clear images of distant galaxies. It took ten years to construct.
Q: What is true about the telescope?
options: A. It was built in ten months.
B. It took a decade to build.
C. It is located in space.
D. It takes blurry pictures.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文中提到 It took ten years (10年) to construct。ten years 也就是 a decade (十年)，因此選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Workplace Notice: All candidates who wish to apply for the senior marketing position must submit a portfolio. Submissions are due this Friday.
Q: What is required from the applicants?
options: A. A job offer.
B. A reference letter.
C. A portfolio of their work.
D. A marketing degree.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：公告中說明申請資深行銷職位的候選人必須提交作品集 (must submit a portfolio)，故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Community Bulletin: The local library is recruiting volunteers to read stories to children on weekends. Anyone who enjoys working with kids is welcome.
Q: What is the main purpose of this notice?
options: A. To sell books.
B. To hire librarians.
C. To host a weekend party.
D. To find weekend volunteers.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：第一句提到圖書館正在招募週末講故事給小孩聽的志工 (recruiting volunteers)，故 D 為此公告的目的。

boss.desc:
【短文】Celebrity Anecdote: The famous chef, whose restaurant recently earned three stars, admitted making a huge mistake in his early career.
Q: What did the chef admit?
options: A. Making an error in the past.
B. Losing his three stars.
C. Closing the restaurant.
D. Blaming his staff.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文中提到名廚承認在他職涯早期犯了一個大錯 (admitted making a huge mistake)。mistake 同義替換為 error，選 A。

boss.desc:
【短文】Travel Blog: While we were wandering through the night market, it began to pour. We had to seek shelter in a small dessert shop.
Q: Why did they go into the dessert shop?
options: A. Because they were hungry.
B. Because it started raining.
C. Because the market closed.
D. Because they wanted dessert.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章提到天空開始傾盆大雨 (began to pour)，所以他們必須去甜點店躲雨 (seek shelter)。選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Science Report: Researchers plan to launch a satellite next month. It will track climate patterns that affect agricultural production.
Q: What is the purpose of the new satellite?
options: A. To monitor space junk.
B. To send humans to space.
C. To track weather patterns.
D. To improve internet speed.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中說明發射衛星的目的是要追蹤影響農業生產的氣候模式 (track climate patterns)，故選 C (weather patterns)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Workplace Case: To boost sales, the company risks alienating its loyal customers by changing the core recipe of its popular drink.
Q: What is the company risking?
options: A. Losing their jobs.
B. Changing the company name.
C. Going bankrupt immediately.
D. Upsetting their loyal customer base.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：公司為了提升銷量更改核心配方，冒著疏遠忠實顧客 (alienating its loyal customers) 的風險。alienate 有使人疏遠、不悅之意，對應 D。

boss.desc:
【短文】Community Notice: The city council has decided to expand the recycling program. Residents who separate their plastics will receive a small tax reduction.
Q: How can residents get a tax reduction?
options: A. By separating plastic waste.
B. By paying more taxes.
C. By expanding the city council.
D. By buying new bins.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到將塑膠分類的居民 (Residents who separate their plastics) 將獲得小幅減稅，故選 A。

boss.desc:
【短文】Celebrity News: The musician, who started playing the piano at age four, released her autobiography last week. She shares the struggles she faced.
Q: When did the musician start playing the piano?
options: A. When she was in high school.
B. When she was a toddler.
C. After she released her book.
D. Ten years ago.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章指出她四歲 (at age four) 開始彈鋼琴。四歲屬於幼童時期 (toddler)，故選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Travel Guide: The temple, which was originally built as a fortress in the 12th century, is now open to the public as a museum.
Q: What was the temple's original purpose?
options: A. It was a royal palace.
B. It was a secret prison.
C. It served as a fortress.
D. It was built in the 20th century.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到這座廟宇最初被建為堡壘 (built as a fortress)，故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Science Article: The biologist was observing the monkeys when she noticed a rare behavior. They were using stones to crack open nuts.
Q: What did the biologist observe?
options: A. Monkeys fighting.
B. Monkeys eating bananas.
C. Monkeys climbing trees.
D. Monkeys using tools.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：生物學家觀察到猴子正在用石頭砸開堅果 (using stones to crack open nuts)，石頭在此被當作工具使用 (tools)，故選 D。

boss.desc:
【短文】Workplace Strategy: Management tends to hire candidates who have at least three years of overseas experience for the international department.
Q: Who is management likely to hire?
options: A. People with foreign work experience.
B. People with high salaries.
C. Fresh graduates.
D. Internal staff only.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到管理層傾向聘用至少有三年海外經驗 (overseas experience) 的候選人。overseas 替換為 foreign，故選 A。

boss.desc:
【短文】Community Update: The neighborhood watch committee, which was formed last year, has successfully reduced local crime rates by twenty percent.
Q: What has the committee achieved?
options: A. An increase in crime.
B. A decrease in crime.
C. A new neighborhood park.
D. Twenty new officers.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：守望相助委員會成功將當地犯罪率降低了百分之二十 (reduced local crime rates by twenty percent)。reduce 對應 decrease，選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Celebrity Interview: During the talk, the actress described struggling to balance her career and family life when she first moved to Hollywood.
Q: What did the actress struggle with?
options: A. Finding a good agent.
B. Moving to Hollywood.
C. Balancing work and family.
D. Learning her lines.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章提到這位女演員在剛搬到好萊塢時，很難在事業與家庭生活間取得平衡 (struggling to balance her career and family life)。故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Store Policy: Customers have 14 days to request a refund. However, we do not accept returning items that have been washed or worn outside.
Q: What action is not accepted for a refund?
options: A. Contacting support.
B. Upgrading membership.
C. Tracking the delivery.
D. Returning washed items.
boss.explain: 政策中提到「we do not accept returning items that have been washed or worn outside」（我們不接受退回已洗過或在戶外穿過的商品）。(D) 符合此敘述。

boss.desc:
【短文】Notice: We regret informing our members that free shipping is no longer available. You can choose to upgrade your membership to enjoy cheaper delivery fees.
Q: What change is the store making?
options: A. Offering free jackets.
B. Canceling free shipping.
C. Lowering membership fees.
D. Delivering items faster.
boss.explain: 公告開頭表示「free shipping is no longer available」（不再提供免運費服務），意味著商店取消了免運費。(B) 為正確答案。

boss.desc:
【短文】Health News: A recent study showed that teenagers who sleep less than seven hours a day tend to crave unhealthy snacks.
Q: Which group of people tends to crave unhealthy snacks?
options: A. Athletes in training.
B. Teenagers who lack sleep.
C. Adults eating vegetables.
D. People drinking green tea.
boss.explain: 研究指出「teenagers who sleep less than seven hours a day tend to crave unhealthy snacks」，亦即睡眠不足的青少年容易渴望不健康的零食。(B) 符合文意。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Why did you hire a health coach?
B: I failed ___ a balanced meal plan on my own.
options: A. create
B. creating
C. to create
D. created
boss.explain: 動詞 fail 後面必須接不定詞（to + V）表示「未能做到某事」。因此 failed to create（無法制定）是唯一正確用法。(C) 正確。

boss.desc:
【短文】Research Article: The scientists hope to discover whether drinking green tea improves metabolism. They plan to publish the results next spring.
Q: What is the scientists' goal?
options: A. To publish a book on sleep.
B. To sleep seven hours.
C. To correct gym postures.
D. To discover green tea's effects.
boss.explain: 文章提到科學家的目的是「hope to discover whether drinking green tea improves metabolism」（希望能發現喝綠茶是否能改善新陳代謝），即了解綠茶的效果。(D) 正確。

boss.desc:
【短文】Memo: The cafeteria that is located on the ground floor offers discounted meals for staff. You just need to show your ID badge.
Q: Where can staff get discounted meals?
options: A. On the top floor.
B. Near the window.
C. At the IT department.
D. In the ground floor cafeteria.
boss.explain: 備忘錄中提到「The cafeteria that is located on the ground floor offers discounted meals」（位於一樓的員工餐廳提供折扣餐點）。(D) 為正確答案。

boss.desc:
【短文】Incident Report: While the new assistant was printing the monthly charts, the printer jammed. She had to ask the IT department for help.
Q: When did the printer jam?
options: A. While she was printing charts.
B. After she went home.
C. During the orientation.
D. When she logged in.
boss.explain: 報告指出「While the new assistant was printing the monthly charts, the printer jammed」，直接說明了印表機卡紙發生的時間點。(A) 完全符合原文。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: I am having trouble logging in.
B: You should think about ___ your password first.
options: A. to reset
B. resetting
C. reset
D. to resetting
boss.explain: 介系詞 about 後方若要接動詞，必須變成動名詞（V-ing）作為受詞。因此 think about resetting（考慮重設）為正確文法。(B) 正確。

boss.desc:
【短文】Tourism Brochure: Visitors who hold a special multi-day pass can skip the lines at most major attractions in the city.
Q: What is the benefit of the multi-day pass?
options: A. Getting free meals.
B. Skipping lines at attractions.
C. Renting a boat for free.
D. Meeting the dancers.
boss.explain: 宣傳冊提到持有特別多日通行證的遊客「can skip the lines at most major attractions」（可在多數主要景點免排隊）。(B) 為正確答案。

boss.desc:
【短文】Festival Guide: To prevent overcrowding, the organizers desire to limit the number of daily tickets. You are advised to book your entry online in advance.
Q: What are the organizers planning to do?
options: A. Stop selling tickets entirely.
B. Cancel the festival.
C. Limit the number of daily tickets.
D. Add more dance performances.
boss.explain: 指南中說明「the organizers desire to limit the number of daily tickets」（主辦單位希望限制每日門票數量）。(C) 正確對應文意。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Are you enjoying the trip?
B: Yes, I can't imagine ___ a better place for a summer vacation.
options: A. to find
B. find
C. found
D. finding
boss.explain: 動詞 imagine（想像）後方接動詞時，必須使用動名詞（V-ing）作受詞。(D) finding 為唯一合乎文法的選項。

boss.desc:
【短文】Forum Post: I was updating my smart watch's software when the screen froze completely. Now it won't even turn on. Has anyone else experienced this?
Q: What was the user doing when the watch froze?
options: A. Updating the software.
B. Listening to music.
C. Changing the strap.
D. Charging the battery.
boss.explain: 貼文提到「I was updating my smart watch's software when the screen froze completely」，說明手錶當機時，發文者正在更新軟體。(A) 正確。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Should I leave it plugged in overnight?
B: No, the manufacturer warns users not ___ the charger plugged in overnight.
options: A. leave
B. to leave
C. leaving
D. left
boss.explain: warn sb. not to do sth. 是固定用法，表示「警告某人不要做某事」，因此必須接不定詞（to leave）。(B) 正確。
