boss.explain: 口說表達「I WAS COOKING WHEN THE ALARM RANG」(phr.)：警報響起時我正在做飯。

boss.desc: 請唸出：你必須避免觸碰該電纜
boss.ans: YOU MUST AVOID TOUCHING THE CABLE
boss.speak: you must avoid touching the cable
boss.explain: 口說表達「YOU MUST AVOID TOUCHING THE CABLE」(phr.)：你必須避免觸碰該電纜。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我推薦雇用這位申請人
boss.speak: i recommend hiring this applicant
boss.explain: 口說表達「I RECOMMEND HIRING THIS APPLICANT」(phr.)：我推薦雇用這位申請人。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們當時正在公園散步
boss.ans: WE WERE WALKING IN THE PARK
boss.speak: we were walking in the park
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE WERE WALKING IN THE PARK」(phr.)：我們當時正在公園散步。

boss.desc: 請唸出：他同意歸還這筆錢
boss.ans: HE AGREED TO RETURN THE MONEY
boss.speak: he agreed to return the money
boss.explain: 口說表達「HE AGREED TO RETURN THE MONEY」(phr.)：他同意歸還這筆錢。

boss.desc: 請唸出：預訂班機的旅行社
boss.ans: THE AGENCY WHICH BOOKED THE FLIGHT
boss.speak: the agency which booked the flight
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE AGENCY WHICH BOOKED THE FLIGHT」(phr.)：預訂班機的旅行社。

boss.desc: 請拼出：社區/鄰近地區
boss.speak: neighborhood
boss.explain: NEIGHBORHOOD (n.)：社區/鄰近地區。例句：We were exploring the neighborhood when we found this cafe.（我們在探索這個社區時發現了這家咖啡館。）

boss.desc: 填空題：N _ I G H B _ R H O _ D (社區/鄰近地區)
boss.speak: neighborhood
boss.explain: NEIGHBORHOOD (n.)：社區/鄰近地區。填空答案為「EOO」。例句：We were exploring the neighborhood when we found this cafe.（我們在探索這個社區時發現了這家咖啡館。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：翻新
boss.speak: renovate
boss.explain: RENOVATE (v.)：翻新。例句：They plan to renovate the office next month.（他們計畫下個月翻新辦公室。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：時間表/安排
boss.speak: schedule
boss.explain: SCHEDULE (n.)：請拼出：時間表/安排。

boss.desc: 填空題：S C H _ D _ L _ (時間表/安排)
boss.speak: schedule
boss.explain: SCHEDULE (n.)：時間表/安排。填空答案為「EUE」。

boss.desc: 請拼出：策略
boss.speak: strategy
boss.explain: STRATEGY (n.)：為達成長期目標安排的行動方式。例句：The strategy depends on saving tokens.（策略依賴保留代幣。）

boss.desc: 填空題：O B J _ C T _ V _ (目標)
boss.speak: objective
boss.explain: OBJECTIVE (n.)：目標。填空答案為「EIE」。例句：Our main objective is to satisfy our customers.（我們的主要目標是讓客戶滿意。）

boss.desc: 填空題：V _ H _ C L _ (車輛)
boss.speak: vehicle
boss.explain: VEHICLE (n.)：車輛。填空答案為「EIE」。例句：You cannot park your vehicle here.（你不能把你的車輛停在這裡。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：社群/社區
boss.speak: community
boss.explain: COMMUNITY (n.)：社區；社群。例句：He has lived in this community for ten years.（他已經在這個社區住了十年了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C O M M _ N _ T _ (社群/社區)
boss.speak: community
boss.explain: COMMUNITY (n.)：社群/社區。填空答案為「UIY」。例句：He has lived in this community for ten years.（他已經在這個社區住了十年了。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：負擔得起的
boss.speak: affordable
boss.explain: AFFORDABLE (adj.)：負擔得起的。例句：Finding affordable housing in the city is getting harder.（在城市裡尋找負擔得起的住房變得越來越困難。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A F F _ R D _ B L _ (負擔得起的)
boss.speak: affordable
boss.explain: AFFORDABLE (adj.)：負擔得起的。填空答案為「OAE」。例句：Finding affordable housing in the city is getting harder.（在城市裡尋找負擔得起的住房變得越來越困難。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C O N V _ N I _ N _ (方便的)
boss.speak: convenient
boss.explain: CONVENIENT (adj.)：方便的。填空答案為「EET」。例句：The new subway line made our daily commute much faster last year.（新地鐵線去年讓我們的日常通勤變快了許多。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The feedback that we received from the participants was overwhelmingly positive.
options: A. 我們從參與者那裡收到的回饋非常負面。
B. 我們從參與者那裡收到的回饋非常正面。
C. 我們從主管那裡收到的回饋非常正面。
D. 參與者拒絕提供任何回饋。
boss.explain: 原句：The feedback that we received from the participants was overwhelmingly positive.（我們從參與者那裡收到的回饋非常正面。）that 為關係代名詞，修飾 feedback。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I was wondering if we could postpone the conference call until tomorrow morning.
options: A. The conference room is very large.
B. I bought a new microphone.
C. That works for me. Let's aim for 10 AM.
D. I was sleeping when you called.
boss.explain: 原句：I was wondering if we could postpone the conference call until tomorrow morning.（我在想我們是否能把電話會議延到明天早上。）回應 C「我沒問題，我們暫定早上十點吧」最恰當。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: She avoids going to the post office during lunch hours because it gets incredibly crowded.
options: A. 她喜歡在午餐時間去郵局，因為那時人很少。
B. 她避免在午餐時間去郵局，因為那時會變得非常擁擠。
C. 她總是在午餐時間去銀行，因為那時非常擁擠。
D. 她忘記在午餐時間去郵局寄信了。
boss.explain: 原句：She avoids going to the post office during lunch hours because it gets incredibly crowded.（她避免在午餐時間去郵局，因為那時會變得非常擁擠。）avoid 後面接動名詞 (going)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The teller who helped me earlier forgot to return my ID card.
options: A. I will check your account balance.
B. Let me go ask her if she has it at her desk.
C. I forgot to bring my credit card.
D. The ID card is valid for five years.
boss.explain: 原句：The teller who helped me earlier forgot to return my ID card.（剛剛幫我的那個出納員忘記把身分證還給我了。）回應 B「我去問她是不是在她桌上」最符合情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: I was checking my account balance online when the banking app suddenly crashed.
options: A. 當我在網路上買東西時，銀行應用程式突然崩潰了。
B. 當我在網上查詢帳戶餘額時，銀行應用程式突然崩潰了。
C. 當我下載銀行應用程式時，我的手機當機了。
D. 當我在查詢餘額時，我的網路斷線了。
boss.explain: 原句：I was checking my account balance online when the banking app suddenly crashed.（當我在網上查詢帳戶餘額時，銀行應用程式突然崩潰了。）為過去進行式的應用。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Do you need me to accompany you to the dental clinic this afternoon?
options: A. The dentist is very professional.
B. No, thanks. I am used to going there by myself.
C. I brush my teeth twice a day.
D. You should avoid eating sweet things.
boss.explain: 原句：Do you need me to accompany you to the dental clinic this afternoon?（你下午需要我陪你去牙科診所嗎？）回應 B「不用了，謝謝。我習慣自己去了」最符合對話邏輯。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The surgeon who performed the operation said that everything went smoothly.
options: A. 負責手術的外科醫生說一切都很順利。
B. 負責手術的護士說病人需要休息。
C. 負責手術的外科醫生說過程有點危險。
D. 那位病人說手術過程非常順利。
boss.explain: 原句：The surgeon who performed the operation said that everything went smoothly.（負責手術的外科醫生說一切都很順利。）who 為關係代名詞修飾 surgeon（外科醫生）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I suggest resting for a few days rather than going back to work immediately.
options: A. The work is very challenging.
B. I will try to follow your advice, doctor.
C. He suggested going to the beach.
D. I was resting when you called.
boss.explain: 原句：I suggest resting for a few days rather than going back to work immediately.（我建議休息幾天，而不是馬上回去工作。）回應 B「醫生，我會試著聽從您的建議」是最佳對答。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: I was looking for some juicy gossip to share, but nothing interesting happened.
options: A. 我正在找一些果汁來分享，但超市沒開。
B. 我正在找一些有趣的八卦來分享，但什麼有趣的事也沒發生。
C. 我正在聽一個有趣的八卦，但我不敢跟別人說。
D. 我正在找一些有趣的書來讀，但沒有好書。
boss.explain: 原句：I was looking for some juicy gossip to share, but nothing interesting happened.（我正在找一些有趣的八卦來分享，但什麼有趣的事也沒發生。）gossip 為八卦，過去進行式 was looking for。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Are you interested in joining us for a hiking trip next Saturday?
options: A. The mountain is very high.
B. I was hiking when it started to rain.
C. I'd love to! Where are we going?
D. You should bring a map.
boss.explain: 原句：Are you interested in joining us for a hiking trip next Saturday?（你有興趣下週六和我們一起去爬山嗎？）回答 C「我很樂意！我們要去哪裡？」最自然。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We ended up abandoning the project which we had been working on for months.
options: A. 我們最後完成了那個做了幾個月的專案。
B. 我們最後放棄了那個我們已經做了好幾個月的專案。
C. 我們最後推遲了那個我們已經做了好幾個月的專案。
D. 我們最後開始了那個討論了幾個月的專案。
boss.explain: 原句：We ended up abandoning the project which we had been working on for months.（我們最後放棄了那個我們已經做了好幾個月的專案。）end up + V-ing（最後...），which 引導關係子句。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The museum strictly prohibits visitors from touching any of the exhibits.
options: A. The exhibit is very beautiful.
B. I will make sure to keep my hands to myself.
C. Visitors can buy tickets online.
D. I was touching the screen.
boss.explain: 原句：The museum strictly prohibits visitors from touching any of the exhibits.（博物館嚴格禁止遊客觸摸任何展品。）回應 B「我會確保管好我的手」表示理解並配合規定。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: They were discussing the new policy when the video call disconnected.
options: A. 當視訊通話斷線時，他們正在討論新政策。
B. 當視訊通話連上時，他們正在討論新政策。
C. 他們因為新政策而中斷了視訊通話。
D. 當視訊通話斷線時，他們正在討論薪水。
boss.explain: 原句：They were discussing the new policy when the video call disconnected.（當視訊通話斷線時，他們正在討論新政策。）過去進行式表達當時進行的動作。

boss.desc:
【短文】Green Living: We urge everyone to consider buying local produce. Doing this helps cut down on transportation emissions.
Q: What does the writer suggest people consider doing?
options: A. To buy local produce.
B. Bought local produce.
C. Buying local produce.
D. Buy local produce.
boss.explain: 【文法與閱讀】題目問作者建議人們考慮做什麼。動詞 consider (考慮) 後方必須接動名詞 (V-ing)，因此正確選項應為 C (Buying local produce)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Eco-Friendly Campaign: The new recycling bin, which contains a smart sensor, automatically sorts paper and plastic. It will be placed in all major subway stations.
Q: What is true about the new recycling bin?
options: A. It was designed by the government.
B. It only collects plastic waste.
C. It requires manual sorting.
D. It can sort materials automatically.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】短文提到「automatically sorts paper and plastic (自動分類紙類與塑膠)」，對應 D 選項「它能自動分類回收物」。其他皆未提及或與文意相反。故選 D。

boss.desc: 【文法】The government aims ___ a nationwide network of electric vehicle charging stations within five years.
options: A. to establish
B. establishing
C. establish
D. established
boss.explain: 【文法】動詞 aim 表示「目標在於、打算」時，後方接不定詞 (to V) 以構成 aim to do something。故選 A。

boss.desc: 【文法】Many remote workers struggle with ___ their professional and personal lives at home.
options: A. separate
B. separated
C. separating
D. to separate
boss.explain: 【文法】struggle with 的 with 是介系詞，介系詞後面的動詞必須改成動名詞 (V-ing) 型態。故選 C (separating)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Office Memo: Yesterday afternoon, while the IT team was upgrading our servers, several employees experienced temporary login issues. The system is now fully restored.
Q: What caused the temporary login issues?
options: A. The server upgrade process.
B. A power outage.
C. A computer virus.
D. Employees forgetting passwords.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】短文指出，問題發生在「while the IT team was upgrading our servers (當 IT 團隊正在升級伺服器時)」，因此造成登入問題的原因是升級過程。故選 A。

boss.desc: 【文法】Remote employees should avoid ___ entirely in their homes without taking breaks outside.
options: A. stay
B. to stay
C. staying
D. stayed
boss.explain: 【文法】avoid (避免) 是一個後方必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 的動詞，表示避免做某事。故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Sports News: The local team, which had lost three consecutive games, finally secured a brilliant victory against the league champions.
Q: What is true about the local team?
options: A. They are the league champions.
B. They have never lost a game.
C. They recently won a game.
D. They decided to change their coach.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】文中提到球隊 secured a brilliant victory (取得漂亮的勝利)，這表示他們最近贏了一場比賽，與 C 選項相符。他們打敗的是聯盟冠軍，本身不是冠軍。故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Live Commentary: The crowd was cheering wildly while the home team was pushing toward the goal line. Out of nowhere, the opposing goalkeeper intercepted the ball.
Q: What was happening when the ball was intercepted?
options: A. The game was paused.
B. The crowd was leaving the stadium.
C. The referee was blowing the whistle.
D. The home team was trying to score.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】短文說「while the home team was pushing toward the goal line (當主場球隊正朝球門線推進時)」，對方守門員攔截了球。推進球門線等同於 trying to score (嘗試得分)。故選 D。

boss.desc: 【文法】If you want a table by the window, you had better attempt ___ it in advance.
options: A. make
B. to book
C. booking
D. booked
boss.explain: 【文法】attempt (嘗試/試圖) 後方應接不定詞 (to V)。選項 B (to book) 意為「預訂」，文法與語意皆正確。故選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Restaurant Review: We strongly suggest trying their chocolate lava cake. It is incredibly rich and melts in your mouth instantly.
Q: What does the reviewer suggest doing?
options: A. Ordering a specific dessert.
B. Asking for a discount.
C. Sharing the cake with friends.
D. Avoiding the sweet dishes.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】評論者強烈建議嘗試「chocolate lava cake (巧克力熔岩蛋糕)」，這是一道特定的甜點 (a specific dessert)。故選 A。

boss.desc: 【文法】The baker ___ created this spectacular wedding cake won a national culinary competition.
options: A. which
B. whom
C. who
D. whose
boss.explain: 【文法】先行詞 The baker (烘焙師) 為人，且在關係子句中作主詞 (創造蛋糕的人)，應填入主格關係代名詞 who。故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Language Forum: Learners who immerse themselves in the target language daily tend to reach fluency much faster than those who only study grammar rules.
Q: According to the forum, who learns faster?
options: A. People who only study grammar.
B. People who ignore the target language.
C. People who regularly surround themselves with the language.
D. People who rarely practice speaking.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】文章提到「immerse themselves in the target language daily (每天讓自己沉浸在目標語言中)」的學習者能更快達到流利程度。immerse 意思接近 surround themselves with (讓自己置身於…之中)。故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Classroom Incident: The teacher was explaining a complex math formula when the smartboard unexpectedly froze. She had to use a traditional whiteboard instead.
Q: What happened while the teacher was explaining the formula?
options: A. The digital equipment stopped working.
B. A student asked a difficult question.
C. The bell rang for the end of class.
D. The classroom lights went out.
boss.explain: 【閱讀】短文指出當老師在講解公式時，smartboard unexpectedly froze (電子白板突然當機不動了)，這對應到 A 選項的 The digital equipment stopped working (數位設備停止運作)。故選 A。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：快遞
boss.speak: courier
boss.explain: 口說表達「COURIER」(n.)：快遞。例句：I will send the documents by courier.（我會用快遞寄送這些文件。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：郊區
boss.speak: suburb
boss.explain: 口說表達「SUBURB」(n.)：郊區。例句：They bought a house in the suburbs.（他們在郊區買了一棟房子。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：技師
boss.speak: mechanic
boss.explain: 口說表達「MECHANIC」(n.)：技師。例句：The mechanic who fixed my car is skilled.（修理我車子的技師技術很好。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：通勤上班
boss.speak: commute to work
boss.explain: 口說表達「COMMUTE TO WORK」(phr.)：通勤上班。

boss.desc: 請唸出：市中心區域
boss.speak: downtown area
boss.explain: 口說表達「DOWNTOWN AREA」(phr.)：市中心區域。

boss.desc: 請唸出：觀光景點
boss.speak: tourist attraction
boss.explain: 口說表達「TOURIST ATTRACTION」(phr.)：觀光景點。

boss.desc: 請唸出：修理我車子的技師技術很好
boss.ans: THE MECHANIC WHO FIXED MY CAR IS SKILLED
boss.speak: the mechanic who fixed my car is skilled
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE MECHANIC WHO FIXED MY CAR IS SKILLED」(phr.)：修理我車子的技師技術很好。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們正在協商時連線中斷了
boss.ans: WE WERE NEGOTIATING WHEN THE CONNECTION DROPPED
boss.speak: we were negotiating when the connection dropped
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE WERE NEGOTIATING WHEN THE CONNECTION DROPPED」(phr.)：我們正在協商時連線中斷了。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我後悔告訴他我的秘密計畫
boss.ans: I REGRET TELLING HIM ABOUT MY SECRET PLAN
boss.speak: i regret telling him about my secret plan
boss.explain: 口說表達「I REGRET TELLING HIM ABOUT MY SECRET PLAN」(phr.)：我後悔告訴他我的秘密計畫。

boss.desc: 請唸出：你有考慮培養新的嗜好嗎
boss.ans: HAVE YOU CONSIDERED TAKING UP A NEW HOBBY
boss.speak: have you considered taking up a new hobby
boss.explain: 口說表達「HAVE YOU CONSIDERED TAKING UP A NEW HOBBY」(phr.)：你有考慮培養新的嗜好嗎。

boss.desc: 請拼出：迷人的
boss.speak: fascinating
boss.explain: FASCINATING (adj.)：迷人的。例句：The museum which we visited yesterday had a fascinating exhibition.（我們昨天參觀的博物館有一個迷人的展覽。）

boss.desc: 填空題：F _ S C _ N _ T I N G (迷人的)
boss.speak: fascinating
boss.explain: FASCINATING (adj.)：迷人的。填空答案為「AIA」。例句：The museum which we visited yesterday had a fascinating exhibition.（我們昨天參觀的博物館有一個迷人的展覽。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S O _ V _ N _ R (紀念品)
boss.speak: souvenir
boss.explain: SOUVENIR (n.)：紀念品。填空答案為「UEI」。

boss.desc: 請拼出：參加
boss.speak: participate
boss.explain: PARTICIPATE (v.)：參加。例句：I decided to participate in the workshop that the company hosted.（我決定參加公司舉辦的工作坊。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P _ R T I C I P _ T _ (參加)
boss.speak: participate
boss.explain: PARTICIPATE (v.)：參加。填空答案為「AAE」。例句：I decided to participate in the workshop that the company hosted.（我決定參加公司舉辦的工作坊。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：替代方案
boss.speak: alternative
boss.explain: ALTERNATIVE (n.)：替代方案；選擇。例句：We have no alternative but to close the store.（除了關閉商店，我們別無選擇。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A L T _ R N _ T I V _ (替代方案)
boss.speak: alternative
boss.explain: ALTERNATIVE (n.)：替代方案。填空答案為「EAE」。例句：We have no alternative but to close the store.（除了關閉商店，我們別無選擇。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：偏好
boss.speak: preference
boss.explain: PREFERENCE (n.)：偏好。例句：Please let me know the preference that you have for the meeting time.（請讓我知道你對會議時間的偏好。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P R _ F E R _ N C _ (偏好)
boss.speak: preference
boss.explain: PREFERENCE (n.)：偏好。填空答案為「EEE」。例句：Please let me know the preference that you have for the meeting time.（請讓我知道你對會議時間的偏好。）

boss.desc: 填空題：L _ N D S C _ P _ (風景)
boss.speak: landscape
boss.explain: LANDSCAPE (n.)：風景。填空答案為「AAE」。例句：The landscape which you can see from the train is amazing.（你從火車上能看到的風景非常驚人。）

boss.desc: 填空題：E X T _ N S _ _ N (延期)
boss.speak: extension
boss.explain: EXTENSION (n.)：延期。填空答案為「EIO」。

boss.desc: 請拼出：出席
boss.speak: attendance
boss.explain: ATTENDANCE (n.)：出席；出席率。例句：Checking attendance is the first thing the teacher does every class.（點名（確認出席）是老師每堂課做的第一件事。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：道地的
boss.speak: authentic
boss.explain: AUTHENTIC (adj.)：道地的。例句：Finding authentic local food is my main goal when traveling.（尋找道地的當地美食是我旅行時的主要目標。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The carpenter who crafted these cabinets is retiring soon.
options: A. 負責油漆這面牆的工人即將被解雇。
B. 修理這些水管的技工正在休長假。
C. 製作這些櫥櫃的木匠很快就要退休了。
D. 設計這些家具的設計師準備換工作。
boss.explain: The carpenter who crafted these cabinets is retiring soon.（製作這些櫥櫃的木匠很快就要退休了。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I was hoping to reschedule the installation of my new air conditioner.
options: A. I hope you can install the software soon.
B. Air conditioners consume a lot of electricity.
C. The installation which we did was a success.
D. Certainly. What dates work best for you?
boss.explain: I was hoping to reschedule the installation of my new air conditioner.（我本來希望能重新安排安裝新冷氣的時間。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The alumni association plans to host a networking event.
options: A. 校友會計畫舉辦一場社交活動。
B. 學生會準備舉辦一場迎新舞會。
C. 家長會提議舉辦一場募款餐會。
D. 董事會打算召開一場緊急會議。
boss.explain: The alumni association plans to host a networking event.（校友會計畫舉辦一場社交活動。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Do you happen to know the person who organized this exhibition?
options: A. I was organizing my desk yesterday.
B. Yes, her name is Sarah, and she is over there.
C. The exhibition which I saw was fascinating.
D. Organizing events requires a lot of patience.
boss.explain: Do you happen to know the person who organized this exhibition?（你碰巧認識組織這個展覽的人嗎？）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: We are looking into resolving the technical glitch immediately.
options: A. 我們正在考慮延後產品的發布時間。
B. 我們正在評估升級系統硬體的可行性。
C. 我們正在調查並立刻解決這個技術故障。
D. 我們正在徵求顧客對於新介面的意見。
boss.explain: We are looking into resolving the technical glitch immediately.（我們正在調查並立刻解決這個技術故障。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The invoice which you sent yesterday contains a calculation error.
options: A. I was calculating the taxes all morning.
B. Sending invoices is part of my daily routine.
C. The error which he made was unavoidable.
D. I sincerely apologize. Let me correct it right away.
boss.explain: The invoice which you sent yesterday contains a calculation error.（你昨天寄的發票包含一個計算錯誤。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The anchor who presented the news seemed very distressed.
options: A. 播報新聞的主播看起來非常苦惱。
B. 負責天氣預報的人員看起來很緊張。
C. 撰寫這篇報導的記者看起來很疲倦。
D. 接受採訪的專家看起來非常有自信。
boss.explain: The anchor who presented the news seemed very distressed.（播報新聞的主播看起來非常苦惱。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I was wondering if you could elaborate on the recent policy changes.
options: A. Changing policies can be a difficult process.
B. Of course. The main update involves working hours.
C. The policy which we adopted is very strict.
D. I was wondering around the park earlier today.
boss.explain: I was wondering if you could elaborate on the recent policy changes.（我想知道你是否能詳細說明最近的政策變更。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The contractor who gave us the estimate is waiting outside.
options: A. I was waiting outside in the freezing cold.
B. Estimating the cost usually takes a long time.
C. Please show him in so we can discuss the details.
D. The estimate which he provided was too low.
boss.explain: The contractor who gave us the estimate is waiting outside.（給我們估價的承包商正在外面等候。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Would you consider lowering the shipping fee for bulk orders?
options: A. I consider myself a very careful driver.
B. The fee which they charged was unreasonable.
C. Bulk orders usually take more time to process.
D. I will have to ask my manager about that discount.
boss.explain: Would you consider lowering the shipping fee for bulk orders?（你會考慮降低大宗訂單的運費嗎？）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The reporter denied fabricating the quotes in his article.
options: A. 記者否認在他的文章中捏造引語。
B. 編輯承認在他的報導中隱瞞了事實。
C. 主播拒絕為他的失言公開道歉。
D. 攝影師反對未經許可使用他的照片。
boss.explain: The reporter denied fabricating the quotes in his article.（記者否認在他的文章中捏造引語。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I was reviewing the blueprint when I noticed a structural flaw.
options: A. The blueprint which we use is very old.
B. That is concerning. Show me exactly where it is.
C. Reviewing documents is part of my daily job.
D. I noticed that you were wearing a new shirt.
boss.explain: I was reviewing the blueprint when I noticed a structural flaw.（我正在審查藍圖時注意到一個結構性缺陷。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The scholarship which she applied for is highly competitive.
options: A. 她參加的比賽競爭非常激烈。
B. 她申請的工作面試難度很高。
C. 她申請的獎學金競爭非常激烈。
D. 她參加的考試錄取率非常低。
boss.explain: The scholarship which she applied for is highly competitive.（她申請的獎學金競爭非常激烈。）

boss.desc: 【文法】The museum curator objected to ___ the rare artifact to the overseas exhibition.
options: A. send
B. sent
C. sending
D. be sent
boss.explain: 本題測驗片語中的動名詞。片語 object to 意為「反對」，其中的 to 是介系詞，而非不定詞的 to，因此後方必須接名詞或動名詞 (V-ing)。故答案為 sending。

boss.desc: 【文法】It is almost impossible for an average earner ___ a property in this expensive district.
options: A. acquiring
B. acquired
C. acquires
D. to acquire
boss.explain: 本題測驗不定詞的特殊句型。It is + 形容詞 + for + 人 + to V，表示「對某人來說做某事是...的」。真正的主詞是不定詞片語 to acquire a property，因此必須選 D。

boss.desc: 【文法】Melatonin is a hormone ___ helps regulate your daily sleep cycle.
options: A. that
B. who
C. whom
D. whose
boss.explain: 本題測驗關係代名詞。先行詞 hormone（荷爾蒙）為事物，因此關代需使用 which 或 that。選項中僅 that 符合條件。who, whom, whose 皆用於與人相關或表所有格的情況。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Did the company catch the person who leaked the data? 
B: Yes, it was a former employee ___ access had not been properly revoked.
options: A. who
B. whose
C. which
D. whom
boss.explain: 本題測驗關係代名詞的所有格。後方的名詞 access（權限）屬於前方的 former employee（前員工），表示「這位前員工的權限」，因此必須使用所有格關係代名詞 whose。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Is the charity gala still happening tonight? 
B: Yes, they ___ the venue when the storm suddenly hit, but everything is fine now.
options: A. decorate
B. have decorated
C. were decorating
D. will decorate
boss.explain: 本題測驗過去進行式。when the storm suddenly hit 表示過去風暴來襲的瞬間，在那個瞬間他們「正在布置」場地，此持續動作需使用過去進行式 were decorating。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Do you remember the historian ___ we met at the conference? 
B: Yes, he specializes in ancient Egyptian culture.
options: A. which
B. whose
C. who
D. whom
boss.explain: 本題測驗關係代名詞。先行詞 historian（歷史學家）是人，在關係子句 "we met ___ at the conference" 中擔任 met 的受詞，因此最精確的用法是受格關係代名詞 whom。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Why are they arguing? 
B: The residents demand ___ compensation from the construction company for the noise pollution.
options: A. to receive
B. receiving
C. received
D. receive
boss.explain: 本題測驗不定詞。動詞 demand（要求）後面必須接不定詞 (to + V) 當作受詞，表示要求去做某事。因此正確選項為 to receive，不能用動名詞 receiving。

boss.desc:
【短文】Sleep Journal: I was analyzing the sleep data from my smartwatch when I realized my deep sleep had significantly decreased. The therapist recommended eliminating caffeine after noon.
Q: What did the therapist suggest?
options: A. Buying a new watch
B. Stopping caffeine intake in the afternoon
C. Sleeping earlier
D. Analyzing the data more often
boss.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解及字彙。治療師建議「eliminating caffeine after noon (中午過後戒除咖啡因)」。eliminate 意為消除、排除，與選項 B (Stopping caffeine intake in the afternoon) 意思完全相同。

boss.desc:
【短文】IT Advisory: Employees who receive emails requesting urgent wire transfers should verify the sender's identity. This is a common tactic used by scammers to bypass security.
Q: What should employees do if asked for an urgent wire transfer?
options: A. Send the money immediately
B. Ignore the email entirely
C. Confirm who actually sent the email
D. Change their password
boss.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。短文中要求員工「verify the sender's identity (驗證寄件者的身分)」，verify 意指確認其真實性，因此選項 C「確認到底是誰寄了這封信」為正確答案。

boss.desc:
【短文】Charity Press Release: The non-profit organization, which focuses on providing clean water, is launching a new campaign in rural areas. They aim to build fifty wells by next year.
Q: What is the main focus of the organization?
options: A. Building schools
B. Donating food
C. Teaching farming
D. Supplying clean water
boss.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。文中的第一句即提到組織的重點是「focuses on providing clean water (專注於提供乾淨水源)」，提供 (providing) 等同於供應 (supplying)，故選 D。

boss.desc:
【短文】Historical Article: While archaeologists were excavating the ancient tomb, they uncovered a hidden chamber containing gold coins. The discovery, which surprised everyone, rewrote local history.
Q: What were the archaeologists doing when they found the chamber?
options: A. Digging at the historical site
B. Selling gold coins
C. Writing a history book
D. Building a tomb
boss.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解與字彙。文中提到「While archaeologists were excavating the ancient tomb (當考古學家正在挖掘古墓時)」。excavate (挖掘) 的同義詞為 dig，古墓也是歷史遺址，因此選項 A 符合文意。

boss.desc:
【短文】Housing Forum: Many young professionals put off buying a house due to soaring prices. Instead, they opt for renting modern apartments that offer shared amenities like gyms and pools.
Q: Why do young professionals delay purchasing houses?
options: A. They prefer small spaces
B. The prices are too high
C. They do not like houses
D. They want to live alone
boss.explain: 本題測驗閱讀理解。文中指出年輕人推遲買房的原因是「due to soaring prices (因為飆升的房價)」。因此選項 B「價格太高」是正確的因果推論。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The itinerary that the travel agency provided seems rather exhausting for elderly participants.
options: A. 旅行社提供的行程對年長參與者來說似乎相當累人。
B. 參與這次旅行的老年人都覺得行程安排得很輕鬆。
C. 旅行社拒絕為老年人提供客製化的行程表。
D. 老年參與者要求旅行社修改原定的出發時間。
boss.explain: The itinerary that the travel agency provided seems rather exhausting for elderly participants.（旅行社提供的行程對年長參與者來說似乎相當累人。）itinerary 指行程，exhausting 為使人精疲力盡的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I was discussing the budget constraints with the committee when the power suddenly went off.
options: A. Did you manage to save the spreadsheet before that happened?
B. The committee always meets on Tuesdays.
C. We are planning to increase the budget next year.
D. The power company will install a new meter soon.
boss.explain: I was discussing the budget constraints with the committee when the power suddenly went off.（我正在和委員會討論預算限制時，突然停電了。）A 選項「在那發生前你有成功存檔試算表嗎？」最符合職場情境的反應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Parents are encouraged to volunteer for the charity bazaar which is scheduled for next month.
options: A. 家長們被鼓勵為定於下個月舉行的慈善義賣活動擔任志工。
B. 學校要求家長必須參加下個月的家長會。
C. 志工們正在努力為家長籌集慈善捐款。
D. 下個月的義賣活動將由學生獨立舉辦。
boss.explain: Parents are encouraged to volunteer for the charity bazaar which is scheduled for next month.（家長們被鼓勵為定於下個月舉行的慈善義賣活動擔任志工。）be encouraged to V 被鼓勵去做...，which引導關係子句修飾 bazaar。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Despite the gloomy forecast, we decided to proceed with the outdoor exhibition.
options: A. I think it was a brave decision. Did it rain after all?
B. The exhibition was mostly about modern art.
C. I was predicting a sunny day for the event.
D. Indoor exhibitions are usually less crowded.
boss.explain: Despite the gloomy forecast, we decided to proceed with the outdoor exhibition.（儘管預報天氣陰沉，我們還是決定繼續舉辦戶外展覽。）A 選項「我認為這是個勇敢的決定。最後有下雨嗎？」回應自然。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: She mentioned struggling to balance her professional responsibilities with her personal life.
options: A. 她提到在平衡專業職責與個人生活方面感到掙扎。
B. 她表示她的工作完全不影響她的私人時間。
C. 她正在尋找一份可以兼顧家庭的新工作。
D. 她抱怨主管總是給她太多專業任務。
boss.explain: She mentioned struggling to balance her professional responsibilities with her personal life.（她提到在平衡專業職責與個人生活方面感到掙扎。）mention + V-ing 表示提及做過或正在經歷的事，struggle 意為掙扎、努力。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The candidate whom we interviewed yesterday clearly lacks practical experience in this field.
options: A. The field is located near the old factory.
B. I agree. We should probably keep searching for a better fit.
C. He has a lot of theoretical knowledge to share.
D. I was interviewing for a different position.
boss.explain: The candidate whom we interviewed yesterday clearly lacks practical experience in this field.（我們昨天面試的那位候選人顯然缺乏這個領域的實務經驗。）B 選項「我同意。我們可能應該繼續尋找更適合的人選」符合招募討論情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Instead of assigning more homework, the teacher emphasized participating in class discussions.
options: A. 老師沒有指派更多作業，而是強調參與課堂討論。
B. 老師不僅指派了更多作業，還要求學生參加討論。
C. 學生們拒絕寫作業，只願意參與課堂討論。
D. 老師認為寫作業比參與課堂討論更重要。
boss.explain: Instead of assigning more homework, the teacher emphasized participating in class discussions.（老師沒有指派更多作業，而是強調參與課堂討論。）Instead of 表示「而不是」，emphasize 後接動名詞表示強調的事情。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I was looking forward to the scenic cruise, but the dense fog ruined the view entirely.
options: A. The cruise ship was built five years ago.
B. What a shame! You must be quite disappointed.
C. Fog consists of tiny water droplets.
D. I plan to take a scenic route tomorrow.
boss.explain: I was looking forward to the scenic cruise, but the dense fog ruined the view entirely.（我本來很期待這趟風景遊輪之旅，但濃霧完全破壞了景色。）B 選項「真可惜！你一定很失望」傳達了同情。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The supervisor who oversees the logistics department is known for being extremely meticulous.
options: A. 負責監督物流部的主管以極度細心聞名。
B. 物流部的員工抱怨主管的要求太過苛刻。
C. 那位主管正在尋找一位細心的物流助理。
D. 大家都知道物流部的主管即將被調職。
boss.explain: The supervisor who oversees the logistics department is known for being extremely meticulous.（負責監督物流部的主管以極度細心聞名。）oversee 意為監督，be known for 意為以...聞名，meticulous 為一絲不苟的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Are you considering appealing the decision that the committee made last week?
options: A. Yes, I firmly believe they misinterpreted the regulations.
B. The committee room is currently occupied.
C. I was deciding what to eat for lunch.
D. The appeal process is generally quite simple.
boss.explain: Are you considering appealing the decision that the committee made last week?（你正在考慮對委員會上週做的決定提出申訴嗎？）A 選項「是的，我堅信他們誤解了規定」符合語境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: They were modifying the assembly line to boost production efficiency.
options: A. 他們正在修改裝配線以提高生產效率。
B. 裝配線的修改導致了生產效率下降。
C. 他們計畫明年關閉這條效率低下的裝配線。
D. 工人們正在抱怨裝配線的設計有缺陷。
boss.explain: They were modifying the assembly line to boost production efficiency.（他們正在修改裝配線以提高生產效率。）modify 意為修改，boost 表示提升，production efficiency 為生產效率。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: It is crucial to verify the references that the applicant provided on their resume.
options: A. The resume should be printed on high-quality paper.
B. I completely agree. I'll start making those calls this afternoon.
C. The applicant arrived fifteen minutes early.
D. I was verifying my bank account balance online.
boss.explain: It is crucial to verify the references that the applicant provided on their resume.（核實申請人在履歷上提供的推薦人是非常重要的。）B 選項「我完全同意。我今天下午就開始打那些電話」最符合招募流程。

boss.desc: 【短文】Executive Interview: 「When I was building the startup, I struggled with delegating tasks,」 the CEO confessed. 「Learning to trust my team was my biggest hurdle.」 Q: What was the CEO doing when he faced his biggest hurdle?
options: A. Taking a long vacation.
B. Selling the company.
C. Establishing the new business.
D. Studying at university.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：CEO 提到在「building the startup」（建立新創公司）時遇到了委派任務的困難，這與 (C) Establishing the new business（建立新事業）意義相同。

boss.desc: 【短文】Lab Precaution: Anyone who handles the acidic solutions must wear protective gloves. Failure to do so could result in severe chemical burns. Q: What is the consequence of not wearing gloves?
options: A. Losing the lab key.
B. Failing the science test.
C. Getting fired immediately.
D. Suffering physical injuries.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文提到不戴手套可能會導致「severe chemical burns」（嚴重的化學灼傷），屬於身體受傷，因此選項 (D) Suffering physical injuries 最符合。

boss.desc: 【文法】The marketing director, ___ innovative campaigns boosted sales, was given a new title yesterday.
options: A. whose
B. who
C. which
D. that
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：此處關係代名詞用來表示所屬關係，「行銷總監『的』創新活動」，因此必須填入所有格關係代名詞 (A) whose。

boss.desc: 【短文】Cultural Exchange: When visiting Japan, slurping noodles is considered a sign of appreciation. However, doing the same in Italy might be viewed as impolite. Q: What does the text imply about eating habits?
options: A. Slurping is hated globally.
B. Table manners vary by region.
C. Italians prefer eating noodles.
D. Japanese chefs dislike noise.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文比較了吸麵條的聲音在日本（代表讚賞）與義大利（被視為無禮）的不同含義，暗示了餐桌禮儀因地區而異，故選 (B)。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Why did the project stop?
B: Management objected to ___ more funds into the research.
options: A. invest
B. to invest
C. investing
D. invested
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：片語 object to（反對）中的 to 是介系詞，後方必須接動名詞 (V-ing)，因此正確答案為 (C) investing。

boss.desc: 【文法】The travelers had difficulty ___ a safe place to pitch their tent during the storm.
options: A. find
B. to find
C. found
D. finding
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：句型 have difficulty (in) V-ing 表示「做某事有困難」，後面必須接動名詞，故選 (D) finding。

boss.desc: 【短文】Company Welfare: To promote mental well-being, the firm has introduced a flexible schedule. Employees who feel overwhelmed can now take mental health days without penalty. Q: What is the purpose of the new flexible schedule?
options: A. To support psychological health.
B. To reduce employee salaries.
C. To increase working hours.
D. To force people to resign.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文章開頭即寫出「To promote mental well-being」（為了促進心理健康），選項 (A) To support psychological health 與之同義。

boss.desc: 【短文】Astronomy News: While astronomers were observing the distant galaxy, they captured an image of a black hole consuming a star. This rare event provides vital data. Q: What was happening when the image was taken?
options: A. The telescope broke down.
B. Scientists were looking at space.
C. A star was creating a galaxy.
D. The astronomers were sleeping.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文提到「While astronomers were observing the distant galaxy...」（當天文學家正在觀察遙遠的星系時），符合 (B) 科學家正在觀察太空。

boss.desc: 【文法】The chef insists on ___ fresh herbs rather than dried ones to enhance the flavor.
options: A. use
B. to use
C. using
D. used
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：insist on（堅持）後方的 on 是介系詞，後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing)，因此正確答案為 (C) using。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: I feel extremely nervous about the flight.
B: Try ___ deep breaths and listening to calm music.
options: A. take
B. to take
C. taken
D. taking
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：try V-ing 表示「嘗試看看（某種方法）」，以觀看效果；且對話後方有 and listening，對稱用法應選 (D) taking。

boss.desc: 【短文】Travel Warning: The local government advises avoiding the eastern district at night. Tourists who wander into that area often report being scammed by fake taxi drivers. Q: Why should tourists avoid the eastern district at night?
options: A. They might be cheated by drivers.
B. The roads are under construction.
C. There are no taxis available.
D. The government is hosting a party.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文指出遊客「report being scammed by fake taxi drivers」（回報被假計程車司機詐騙），這與 (A) They might be cheated by drivers 意思相符。

boss.desc: 【短文】Artist Profile: The sculptor, whose works are displayed globally, confessed to feeling anxious before every exhibition. 「Perfection is an illusion,」 she stated. Q: What did the sculptor confess?
options: A. She hates traveling globally.
B. She gets nervous before shows.
C. Her sculptures are illusions.
D. She creates perfect art.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：雕刻家坦承「feeling anxious before every exhibition」（在每次展覽前感到焦慮），這與 (B) She gets nervous before shows 意思完全相同。

boss.desc: 請拼出：便利
boss.speak: convenience
boss.explain: CONVENIENCE (n.)：便利。例句：We are adding new features to increase your convenience.（我們正在增加新功能以提升您的便利性。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：核銷/退還
boss.speak: reimburse
boss.explain: REIMBURSE (v.)：償還他人已代墊的費用。例句：The club will reimburse agreed expenses.（俱樂部會報銷議定支出。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：打擾/干擾
boss.speak: disturbance
boss.explain: DISTURBANCE (n.)：打擾/干擾。例句：We apologize for creating a disturbance during the renovation.（我們對於在翻修期間造成的打擾深表歉意。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C O M P _ N S _ T I _ N (補償)
boss.speak: compensation
boss.explain: COMPENSATION (n.)：補償。填空答案為「EAO」。

boss.desc: 填空題：G _ _ R A N T _ E (保證)
boss.speak: guarantee
boss.explain: GUARANTEE (v.)：保證。填空答案為「UAE」。例句：We guarantee the quality of our products.（我們保證產品的品質。）

boss.desc: 填空題：E M B _ R R _ S S _ D (尷尬的)
boss.speak: embarrassed
boss.explain: EMBARRASSED (adj.)：尷尬的。填空答案為「AAE」。例句：I felt embarrassed about making a mistake during the community meeting.（對於在社區會議中犯錯，我感到很尷尬。）

boss.desc: 填空題：E X H _ B _ T I _ N (展覽)
boss.speak: exhibition
boss.explain: EXHIBITION (n.)：展覽。填空答案為「IIO」。例句：The exhibition has been visited by many people.（許多人已經參觀過這個展覽。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R _ C O M M _ N D A T I _ N (推薦)
boss.speak: recommendation
boss.explain: RECOMMENDATION (n.)：推薦。填空答案為「EEO」。例句：We are writing to give a recommendation for the new software.（我們寫信是為了給這款新軟體提供推薦。）

boss.desc: 填空題：M _ I N T _ N A N C _ (維護/保養)
boss.speak: maintenance
boss.explain: MAINTENANCE (n.)：維護/保養。填空答案為「AEE」。例句：The machine needs regular maintenance.（這台機器需要定期維護。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A N N _ _ N C E M _ N T (公告)
boss.speak: announcement
boss.explain: ANNOUNCEMENT (n.)：公告。填空答案為「OUE」。例句：I am writing to make an announcement regarding the upcoming trip.（我寫信是為了針對即將到來的旅行發布一則公告。）

boss.desc: 填空題：T _ M P O R _ R _ (暫時的)
boss.speak: temporary
boss.explain: TEMPORARY (n.)：暫時的。填空答案為「EAY」。

boss.desc: 填空題：C O N V _ N I _ N C _ (便利)
boss.speak: convenience
boss.explain: CONVENIENCE (n.)：便利。填空答案為「EEE」。例句：We are adding new features to increase your convenience.（我們正在增加新功能以提升您的便利性。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R E _ M B _ R S _ (核銷/退還)
boss.speak: reimburse
boss.explain: REIMBURSE (v.)：核銷/退還。填空答案為「IUE」。例句：The club will reimburse agreed expenses.（俱樂部會報銷議定支出。）

boss.desc: 填空題：D I S T _ R B _ N C _ (打擾/干擾)
boss.speak: disturbance
boss.explain: DISTURBANCE (n.)：打擾/干擾。填空答案為「UAE」。例句：We apologize for creating a disturbance during the renovation.（我們對於在翻修期間造成的打擾深表歉意。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I was checking out when the receptionist told me about the extra charges.
options: A. The receptionist is very busy now.
B. What were those extra fees for?
C. I charged my phone in the room.

boss.explain: I was checking out when the receptionist told me about the extra charges. (我在退房時，櫃檯接待員告訴我有額外的費用。) 回應 B (那些額外費用是做什麼的？) 最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The estimate that you provided seems slightly inaccurate.
options: A. I am providing a new service.

boss.explain: The estimate that you provided seems slightly inaccurate. (你提供的估計似乎有點不準確。) 回應 B (讓我重新審視數字並更新它) 最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: She mentioned updating the project files before she left.
options: A. 她提到離開前會備份專案檔案。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: We are considering buying a guidebook for our trip to Italy.

boss.explain: We are considering buying a guidebook for our trip to Italy. (我們考慮買一本義大利旅遊指南。) 回應 A (找尋隱藏的當地景點是個聰明的主意) 最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The cruise that travels to Alaska departs next Sunday.
options: A. 前往阿拉斯加的火車下週日出發。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I was practicing the new drill when I pulled a muscle.
options: A. The drill is in the toolbox.

boss.explain: I was practicing the new drill when I pulled a muscle. (我在練習新訓練動作時拉傷了肌肉。) 回應 B (你應該休息並冰敷一下) 最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: It is essential to stay hydrated during intense workouts.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The tactic which we used in the first half isn't working anymore.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The referee who made the final call was heavily criticized.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The trolley that I grabbed has a broken wheel.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Why are they blocking the intersection?
B: They are discussing ___ a pedestrian zone in this area.
options: A. to create
B. create
C. created
D. creating
boss.explain: 本題考動名詞用法。動詞 discuss（討論）後面必須直接加動名詞 (V-ing) 作為受詞，不可加 to V。

boss.desc:
【短文】City News: While the construction workers were digging near the harbor, they uncovered an unexploded bomb from the war. The entire district was evacuated immediately.
Q: What happened while the workers were digging?
options: A. They found a hidden treasure.
B. They accidentally triggered an explosion.
C. They discovered a new water pipe.
D. They found a dangerous explosive.
boss.explain: 閱讀理解與字彙題。文中指出工人在挖掘時發現了一枚未爆彈（unexploded bomb），對應選項 D 的危險爆裂物（dangerous explosive）。

boss.desc:
【短文】Public Notice: We kindly request residents to avoid ___ their trash bins on the sidewalk during the weekend. The collection trucks only operate from Monday to Friday.
Q: Fill in the blank with the correct grammar form.
options: A. leaving
B. to leave
C. leave
D. left
boss.explain: 本題在短文中考動名詞用法。動詞 avoid（避免）後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing)，因此答案為 leaving。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Have you met the new MENTOR?
B: Yes, she is the person ___ we hired to improve our team's productivity.
options: A. which
B. whom
C. whose
D. what
boss.explain: 本題考關係代名詞。先行詞 person 為人，在關係子句中作動詞 hired 的受詞，因此應使用受格關係代名詞 whom（或 who/that）。

boss.desc:
【短文】Management Advice: When dealing with a DISPUTE, a good leader shouldn't pretend ___ everything. Listening to both sides is always the best approach.
Q: Fill in the blank with the correct grammar form.
options: A. know
B. to know
C. knowing
D. knew
boss.explain: 本題在短文中考不定詞用法。動詞 pretend（假裝）後面必須接不定詞 (to V)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Workplace Story: I was collaborating with the design team when I noticed a major flaw in the software. Thanks to that, we fixed it before the launch.
Q: What was the narrator doing when they spotted the error?
options: A. Launching the software.
B. Taking a break in the office.
C. Working together with the designers.
D. Arguing with the manager.
boss.explain: 閱讀理解與時態題。文中提到 I was collaborating with the design team... 意即與設計團隊合作，與選項 C (Working together) 相符。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Why did you hire a personal trainer?
B: I was struggling ___ weight on my own.
options: A. lose
B. losing
C. lost
D. to lose
boss.explain: 本題考不定詞用法。動詞 struggle（努力/掙扎）後面接不定詞 (to V) 表示努力去做某事。

boss.desc:
【短文】Fitness Blog: I was lifting weights at the gym when I felt a sharp pain in my shoulder. My physical therapist suggested ___ heavy objects for at least two weeks.
Q: Fill in the blank with the correct grammar form.
options: A. to avoid
B. avoid
C. avoided
D. avoiding
boss.explain: 本題在短文中考動名詞用法。動詞 suggest（建議）後面必須直接接動名詞 (V-ing)，不能用 to V。

boss.desc:
【短文】Medical News: A new THERAPY, which involves exposing patients to extreme cold, is gaining popularity among professional athletes. It claims to speed up muscle recovery.
Q: What is true about the new therapy?
options: A. It uses cold temperatures to help muscles recover.
B. It is only available to amateurs.
C. It requires patients to stay in a hot room.
D. It causes severe muscle damage.
boss.explain: 閱讀理解題。文中描述這項療法將病患暴露在極度低溫中（extreme cold），並宣稱能加速肌肉恢復（speed up muscle recovery），故選 A。

boss.desc:
【短文】Museum Rule: Visitors are strictly forbidden from touching the artworks. The museum management risks ___ its license if artifacts are damaged.
Q: Fill in the blank with the correct grammar form.
options: A. lose
B. losing
C. to lose
D. lost
boss.explain: 本題在短文中考動名詞用法。動詞 risk（冒...的風險）後面必須接動名詞 (V-ing) 作受詞。

boss.desc:
【短文】Theater Review: While the lead actor was delivering his emotional monologue, a phone in the front row started ringing loudly. It ruined the entire mood of the play.
Q: What happened during the emotional scene?
options: A. The actor forgot his lines.
B. The lights suddenly went out.
C. Someone's phone interrupted the performance.
D. The audience started clapping.
boss.explain: 閱讀理解題。文中提到主角在說獨白時，前排有電話大聲響起（a phone started ringing loudly），破壞了整體氣氛，故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Banking Alert: Customers who notice any unusual charges on their statement should report them immediately. The bank claims ___ all fraudulent activities within a week.
Q: Choose the correct grammar form.
options: A. investigating
B. investigated
C. investigate
D. to investigate
boss.explain: 本題在短文中考不定詞用法。動詞 claim（宣稱）後接不定詞 (to V) 表示宣稱會做某事。

boss.desc:
【短文】Market News: While the central bank was trying to control INFLATION, local retail sales dropped significantly. Consumers are now spending less on entertainment.
Q: What occurred during the central bank's effort to control inflation?
options: A. People bought fewer items at retail stores.
B. Entertainment expenses increased.
C. The bank went bankrupt.
D. Prices of essential goods dropped.
boss.explain: 閱讀理解題。文中提到當央行試圖控制通膨時，本地零售銷售大幅下降（retail sales dropped significantly），這表示人們在零售店買的物品變少了，故選 A。
